mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation, a good and stable work environment, and plenty of growth opportunities.

nts and appropriate trends

mbers to create shot lists for social media, as needed

title: SEO & Website Specialist (AI-Forward)
description:
About the role



We're a US-based company managing SEO and websites across a portfolio of brands, and we're looking for an SEO & Website Specialist who is genuinely AI-forward — someone who reaches for AI tools first and knows how to get real output from them.



Here's what makes this different from most SEO roles: we've built a proprietary internal AI toolset that already handles roughly 90% of the connections and heavy lifting needed to execute the work. You won't be stitching together a dozen subscriptions or grinding through everything by hand. Your job is to drive that system — to be the skilled operator who knows what good SEO looks like and uses our tools to produce it at a level most people can't match manually.



This is an upgrade hire. We're looking for someone better than "posts content and reports rankings." If you understand why things rank, communicate clearly when you hit a wall, and have an eye for a clean website, keep reading.



What you'll do



Own SEO execution across multiple brand websites — on-page, technical, content, and local SEO

Use our internal AI toolset as your primary driver for research, content, optimization, and reporting

Manage website updates, page builds, and general site health

Diagnose ranking and technical issues, and clearly explain what you're seeing and what you'd do about it

Keep a sharp eye on design and layout so pages look professional, not just optimized

Flag hurdles early and communicate proactively — we'd much rather hear "here's where I'm stuck" than discover a stalled project two weeks later



What we're looking for



Solid grasp of SEO fundamentals: how search engines rank, on-page vs. off-page, technical SEO, site structure, keyword and content strategy

Real website management experience — comfortable in page builders and CMS platforms, basic understanding of HTML/CSS a plus

Genuinely AI-forward: you already use AI tools in your daily workflow and can show how they've made your work better or faster

Strong written English and clear, proactive communication

A good design eye — you can tell the difference between a page that looks credible and one that doesn't

Self-directed and reliable, with the judgment to know when to push ahead and when to raise a flag



Compensation & growth



Starting at $800 USD/month, full-time. We see this as a starting point, not a ceiling — there is real room for growth in both pay and responsibility for the right person who proves they can drive results. If you're the operator we're hoping to find, you'll have room to grow with us.



To apply



Please do the following so we know you actually read this:



Start your application with the word "Signal" so we know you're not a copy-paste applicant.

Briefly tell us about an AI tool or workflow you use in your SEO or web work today, and what it's changed about how you work.

Share 1–2 examples of websites or SEO results you've worked on (links preferred).

In one or two sentences, describe a time you hit a technical or ranking hurdle — what it was and how you communicated it.



We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip them won't be considered.

title: Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager
description:
Barrister Premier Properties, LLC

Mandeville / Covington — Northshore Louisiana



Barrister Premier Properties, LLC is seeking an experienced, hands-on Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager to take ownership of maintenance and field operations across our portfolio of multifamily apartments, hotels, shopping centers, commercial properties, and tenant spaces throughout the Northshore.



We are looking for someone with strong construction and property maintenance experience who can diagnose problems, determine the correct repair solution, lead a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew, manage work orders, procure materials, and personally perform or assist with repairs when needed.



Key Responsibilities



-Manage, assign, prioritize, and track daily maintenance work orders.

-Lead, supervise, and hold accountable a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew.

-Diagnose building, construction, and maintenance issues and determine the appropriate repair solution.

-Create scopes of work, material lists, and basic material takeoffs.

-Purchase and stage materials ahead of scheduled work and respond quickly to emergency material needs.

-Perform hands-on repairs and maintenance alongside the crew when necessary.

-Conduct regular property walks and inspections to identify maintenance needs before they become larger problems.

-Perform tenant and resident move-out inspections and coordinate turnover work.

-Establish and maintain preventative maintenance schedules across the portfolio.

-Respond to emergency maintenance issues and prioritize work based on urgency, safety, property damage exposure, and operational impact.

-Track outstanding repairs and ensure work is completed properly, timely, and to company standards.

-Coordinate with outside subcontractors when work requires specialized trades or additional manpower.

-Verify completed work and maintain accountability for quality, materials, labor, and company resources.

-Take full ownership of maintenance issues from initial diagnosis through final completion.



Qualifications



-5+ years of experience in construction, property maintenance, facilities maintenance, or maintenance supervision.

-Strong working knowledge of multiple trades, including:

            -Carpentry and general construction

            -Plumbing

            -Electrical

            -HVAC

            -Drywall

            -Painting and finishes

-Proven ability to lead and manage maintenance or construction personnel.

-Experience preparing scopes of work, material takeoffs, and purchasing materials.

-Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.

-Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple active work orders and properties simultaneously.

-Comfortable working in the field daily and performing hands-on work when required.

-Reliable transportation and a clean driving record.

-Strong communication skills and professional presence when interacting with tenants, residents, vendors, subcontractors, and company personnel.



Ideal Candidate



-We are looking for someone who is hands-on, dependable, organized, decisive, and accountable.

-The right candidate should be able to walk into a property, identify the problem, determine the appropriate solution, obtain the necessary materials, assign or perform the work, and make sure the job is completed correctly.

-You should be comfortable making decisions in the field, working under pressure, managing competing priorities, leading a crew, and treating company properties, materials, equipment, and resources as if they were your own.

-We want someone who does not simply identify problems or pass them along. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the problem and drives it through completion.

-This position is critical to establishing and maintaining a reliable, organized, responsive, and accountable in-house property maintenance operation across the Barrister Premier Properties portfolio.

title: CLNR Studios | Creative Scriptwriter — Short-Form Stories & Branded Content
description:
About CLNR Studios



CLNR Studios is a US-based content production and growth agency creating short-form video for brands, founders, and businesses.

We want to make content that feels imaginative, playful, cinematic, and memorable—not like another scripted advertisement. We’re looking for a creative storyteller who can transform simple ideas into entertaining short-form stories people genuinely want to watch.

The Role



We’re looking for a Creative Scriptwriter who can develop whimsical, emotionally engaging stories for short-form video.



You’ll receive a client brief, message, product, or rough idea and turn it into an original story with characters, personality, visual moments, and a satisfying payoff. 



The brand should feel naturally woven into the story rather than forced into a traditional advertisement.



This is not a blog-writing, caption-writing, or generic marketing-copy role. We want someone who thinks in scenes, characters, actions, and images—and understands how written ideas will come to life on camera.



What You’ll Do

- Develop imaginative concepts from client briefs and rough ideas.

- Find playful, unexpected ways to communicate a brand’s message.

- Write short narrative scripts with personality, emotion, humor, or wonder.

- Create memorable characters, scenarios, and visual worlds.

- Write natural dialogue, voiceover, action, and performance direction.

- Build stories with a strong opening, clear progression, and rewarding ending.

- Use visual storytelling instead of relying entirely on spoken explanations.

- Create treatments, loglines, character descriptions, and story outlines.

- Write clear scene descriptions that can be passed to a storyboard artist.

- Adapt your voice to different brands while preserving originality.

- Develop alternate concepts, openings, and endings when requested.

- Collaborate with our creative producer, storyboard artist, and production team.

- Revise scripts based on creative direction and client feedback.

- Keep concepts achievable within the project’s budget, locations, talent, and production schedule.



The Kind of Stories We Want

Our scripts may be:

- Whimsical and imaginative

- Funny or slightly absurd

- Heartfelt and human

- Character-driven

- Visually surprising

- Cinematic but concise

- Inspired by everyday moments

- Built around metaphors or visual transformations

- Playful without feeling childish

- Branded without feeling like traditional advertising

Projects may include short narrative films, sketches, product stories, founder stories, visual comedy, emotional brand pieces, and episodic short-form concepts.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience writing scripts, short films, sketches, branded stories, animation, or narrative video.

- A strong understanding of character, story structure, pacing, dialogue, and payoff.

- The ability to create an engaging story within 15 seconds to three minutes.

- A vivid imagination and a distinctive creative perspective.

- Strong visual thinking—you can imagine what the audience will see, not only what they will hear.

- The ability to make ordinary products or ideas feel interesting and emotionally meaningful.

- Excellent written English.

- The ability to write dialogue that feels natural when performed.

- Comfort receiving feedback and revising creative work.

- Reliable communication and deadline management.

- The ability to balance originality with real production limitations.



Helpful Experience

- Short films

- Comedy sketches

- Children’s or family entertainment

- Animation

- Branded entertainment

- Music videos

- Theater or playwriting

- Visual storytelling

- Character development

- Magical realism

- Commercial or agency production



Marketing experience is helpful but not required. Strong storytelling instincts are more important.



Typical Deliverables



Depending on the project, you may provide:

- Two or three concept options

- Logline and synopsis

- Creative treatment

- Character descriptions

- Story outline

- Complete short-form script

- Dialogue or voiceover

- Visual action and scene direction

- Performance and tone notes

- Alternate openings or endings

- Revisions following feedback

title: PT Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Part-Time Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist



**Paid Ads • Funnels • Lead Generation • Automation**



**Company:** 

**Hours:** Part-time (~10 hours/week to start, with potential to grow) - during New York Work hours

**Compensation:** Hourly + Performance-Based Bonuses



## About Us




 is an employee benefits and health insurance agency helping small and mid-sized businesses navigate their employee benefit programs.



We’re looking for a **creative, results-driven, and tech-savvy Marketing Specialist** who can help us generate more qualified employer leads and build a repeatable marketing system that consistently brings new opportunities into our agency.



Our primary goal is simple: **get in front of business owners and decision-makers who are responsible for their company's employee benefits.**



## The Opportunity



We are looking for someone who understands **lead generation — not just posting on social media.**



You’ll work directly with leadership to develop and execute campaigns designed to attract small and mid-sized employers who may be reviewing their health insurance, looking for a new benefits broker, struggling with rising costs, or simply looking for better guidance.



This may include paid advertising, landing pages, lead magnets,
 campaigns, retargeting, CRM automation, and testing different offers and audiences to determine what actually generates qualified leads.



This position will start at approximately **20 hours per week**, with the opportunity to grow based on performance.



## What You'll Do



* **Generate qualified employer leads** through paid advertising, funnels,
 campaigns, retargeting, and other digital strategies

* **Build marketing funnels and landing pages** designed to convert business owners and HR/benefits decision-makers

* **Create compelling offers and lead magnets** around employee benefits, renewals, cost-saving strategies, compliance, and related topics

* **Manage and optimize paid advertising**, including Meta/Facebook campaigns and potentially other channels such as Google or LinkedIn

* **Build lead nurturing campaigns** so prospects who aren't ready today remain engaged with our agency

* **Connect marketing systems with our CRM** and automate lead follow-up, tracking, notifications, and pipeline management

* **Track results** including cost per lead, qualified leads, booked appointments, conversion rates, and ultimately new business generated

* **Test and improve campaigns** based on actual performance rather than simply launching campaigns and leaving them alone

* **Assist with 
** by recommending and implementing improvements that could increase website traffic, conversions, quote requests, and booked consultations



Website work is important, but **our primary focus for this position is generating qualified new business opportunities.**



## Must-Have Experience



We're looking for someone who has hands-on experience with:



* Lead generation and digital marketing

* Meta/Facebook Ads

* Marketing funnels and landing pages

* Lead magnets and marketing content

*
 drip/nurture campaigns

* CRM and marketing automation

* Zapier, Make, APIs, or similar integration tools

* WordPress websites

* Tracking campaign performance and conversion metrics

* Testing and optimizing campaigns based on results



Experience with **B2B lead generation** is especially important. We are marketing to employers and business decision-makers, not individual consumers.



## Bonus Points If You



* Have experience marketing **employee benefits, health insurance, insurance agencies, financial services, or other B2B professional services**

* Have successfully generated leads from small and mid-sized businesses

* Understand Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO, or local search

* Have experience with **Salesmate CRM, Jotform, Calendly, WordPress, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms**

* Understand CRM pipelines and lead attribution

* Can help improve website conversion rates and organic lead generation

* Can provide examples of campaigns where you can show actual results



## What Success Looks Like



We don't want to measure this position based on how many posts were created or
s were sent.



We want to see **measurable growth in qualified employer leads, booked appointments, and opportunities entering our sales pipeline.**



We're looking for someone who enjoys testing ideas, studying the numbers, improving campaigns, and figuring out how to generate better leads at a reasonable acquisition cost.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



**1. A short 2–3 minute video** introducing yourself and explaining:



* Your experience generating B2B leads

* Your experience with paid ads, funnels, and marketing automation

* An example of a campaign you personally created and the results it generated

* How you would approach generating leads for an employee benefits agency targeting small and mid-sized businesses



**2. Your resume**



**3. Examples of your work**, including funnels, landing pages, advertisements, lead magnets, or campaign results if available.



Please do not send a generic marketing or VA application. We're specifically looking for someone who can **build, test, track, and improve a lead-generation system** and who is comfortable being measured by results.



We're excited to find someone who can grow with 
 and become an important part of our long-term marketing strategy.

title: (Von) Social Media Content Strategist & Manager - Relationship Coaching Brand (GHL)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

• Location: Remote

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Position: Part-Time

• Hours: 20 hours per week

• Pay: $250 per month ($62.50 per week)

• Brand: Relationship Coaching

• Time Zone: Availability to overlap with US working hours



ABOUT THE ROLE



YOU MUST HAVE BASIC KNOWLEDGE OF GO HIGH LEVEL



I’m looking for a hands-on Content Strategist & Social Media Manager to help grow a relationship coaching brand focused on helping estranged parents and grandparents rebuild and strengthen relationships with their children and grandchildren.

This is not simply a role where you will be given a list of posts to create each week. I need someone who can think strategically, understand the audience, research competitors, analyze content and performance, identify opportunities and take ownership of the process from research → strategy → content creation → scheduling → analytics → optimization.

You should be comfortable working independently, bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you believe certain content will work.



THE MAIN GOAL



The primary focus of this role is audience growth, reach and engagement.

The goal is to build a strong and relevant audience around the brand, increase visibility and establish the brand as a trusted voice within the relationship coaching space.



This means understanding what makes people stop scrolling, engage, share and follow, while ensuring the content remains relevant to the people the brand is trying to reach.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Strategy & Research

• Research the target audience, including their questions, problems, emotions, concerns and interests

• Research competitors and successful creators in the relationship coaching and family/relationship space

• Analyze existing content and identify what is working, what isn’t and why

• Develop and maintain content pillars, themes and a platform-specific strategy

• Identify content gaps, trends and opportunities, work closely with teammates  

• Use audience response and analytics to continually improve the strategy



Content Creation

• Develop content ideas, angles and hooks

• Write captions, titles, descriptions and CTAs

• Adapt content to the brand’s voice and different platforms.

• Review short-form edits and design thumbnails

• Create social media carousel reels 

• Ideas for existing content into new formats

• Develop different creative angles around topics that are already performing well

AI can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must have genuine human judgement, creativity and personality.



Planning & Publishing

• Build and manage the content calendar

• Schedule and publish content across relevant platforms

• Ensure content, captions, CTAs, links and formatting are correct and work with the teammates 

• Keep the content workflow organized and ahead of schedule



Analytics & Growth

• Monitor views, reach, watch time, retention, engagement, saves, shares, comments, follower growth and other relevant metrics

• Identify patterns in what is performing well and use those insights to double down on successful topics, formats and content approaches

• Identify high-performing content and develop new angles, variations and repurposing opportunities

• Test different hooks, topics, formats, CTAs and content approaches to understand what resonates best

• Use analytics and audience response to continually refine and improve the content strategy

• Recommend what should be created more of, changed or stopped



Community

• Monitor and respond to comments and basic messages

• Encourage meaningful audience interaction and conversation

• Identify audience questions and recurring themes that could become future content

• Escalate anything requiring the owner’s input



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

• Experience in GO HIGH LEVEL, content strategy and social media management, preferably for a personal brand, creator, coach, educator or similar business

• Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube

• Strong understanding of audience and competitor research

• Strong content creation and copywriting skills

• Ability to create engaging content that feels natural and authentic to the brand

• Ability to analyze content performance and turn data into action

• Strong graphic design skills, including creating social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails

• Understanding of SEO/keyword research for social media and YouTube

• Able to work independently and take ownership

• Strong attention to detail and ability to MEET DEADLINES!



APPLICATION & SELECTION PROCESS

Please note that shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical trial before a hiring decision is made.

The trial will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to think strategically, understand an audience, develop content ideas and create content.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Brand Designer and Graphic Design Assistant Needed to Expand Existing Brand
description:
I am looking for an experienced brand and graphic designer to help expand the existing brand identity for Great Stone Dragon, a collectible fantasy pin business, into a complete and cohesive visual system across packaging, printed materials, ecommerce, events, and social media.



I already have a professionally created brand guide with established logos, colors, typography, patterns, icons, and overall visual direction. I am not looking for a new logo or a complete rebrand.



Instead, I am looking for someone who can take the existing identity, understand the brand direction, and creatively expand it across all areas of the business.



This is also intended to be an ongoing creative support role, so I am looking for someone who can become familiar with the brand over time, understand my preferences, and confidently create materials without needing constant direction or micromanagement.



Brand Direction



The visual direction I want to continue developing is an elevated version of my current branding that I refer to as Bold Heritage.



The brand should feel:



• Rich

• Collectible

• Premium

• Whimsical

• Slightly luxurious

• Approachable

• Recognizable



The primary visual direction uses burgundy, gold, ivory, and navy along with the existing Great Stone Dragon cloud motifs, dragon imagery, decorative borders, patterns, and Asian inspired visual elements already established within the brand.



The goal is not to redesign the identity, but to take the existing foundation and turn it into a much stronger and more recognizable brand system.



Scope of Work

Packaging



I would like the designer to help create and expand packaging concepts such as:



• Branded shipping boxes and mailer boxes

• Bubble mailers in multiple sizes

• Poly mailers

• Custom tissue paper

• Tissue paper sticker seals

• Packing tape

• Shipping labels

• Product protection and inner packaging

• Box inserts

• Unboxing presentation

• Belly bands

• Ribbon or packaging wraps

• Other creative packaging concepts that strengthen the customer experience



Product and Order Collateral



Design needs may include:



• Pin backing cards with adaptable layouts for different pin sizes

• Thank you cards

• Business cards

• Order insert cards

• Pin care cards

• Authenticity or collector cards

• QR code cards

• Sticker designs

• Sticker sheets

• Logo seals

• Promotional cards

• Bookmarks

• Collectible inserts

• Other branded materials included with customer orders



Event and Vendor Materials



I also attend pin trading events and vendor events, so I need cohesive event branding including:



• Table signage

• Pricing signs

• QR code signs

• Business card or flyer displays

• Banners

• Table runners

• Booth branding

• Shopping bags

• Event specific promotional materials

• Packaging specifically designed for in person purchases



Social Media Branding



One of the largest areas I want to improve is the overall consistency and recognizability of my social media presence.



I do not want every post to look identical, but I want everything to clearly feel like it belongs to the same brand.



This may include:



• Complete Instagram feed direction

• Example 3 x 3 grids showing how different content types work together

• Product release templates

• Presale announcement templates

• In hand sale templates

• Restock templates

• Coming soon templates

• Production update templates

• Informational graphics

• Event announcement templates

• Collection or series spotlight templates

• Instagram Story templates

• Instagram Highlight covers

• Reel covers

• Giveaway graphics

• Website announcement graphics

• Other recurring promotional content



The goal is to create a recognizable design system where someone can immediately identify a Great Stone Dragon post even before seeing the account name.



Additional Digital Applications



I may also need designs or templates for:



•
 marketing headers and graphics

• Order confirmation and shipping
 branding

• Website banners

• Homepage promotional graphics

• Collection graphics

• Digital advertisements

• 
 announcement graphics

• Other digital marketing materials as needed



Canva Experience Is Required



Strong Canva experience is required for this role.



While experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or other professional design software is valuable, many of the recurring materials for my business need to be created or recreated as editable Canva templates.



I need to be able to easily update elements such as:



• Product images

• Product names

• Dates

• Pricing

• Release information

• Event details

• Text and announcements



Templates should be organized, easy to edit, and built in a way that allows me or another team member to update them without a
 disrupting the overall design.



The designer should be comfortable creating professional designs within Canva rather than viewing Canva only as a basic design tool.



What I Need From the Designer



I am looking for more than someone who can create individual graphics when given exact instructions.



I want someone who can help create a repeatable and recognizable visual system for the brand.



For major brand applications, I would like thoughtful decisions around:



• Which logo variation should be used

• Primary and secondary color combinations

• Appropriate patterns and graphics

• Typography hierarchy

• Spacing and layout

• Visual consistency

• How designs should adapt across different sizes and formats



I also want someone who can look at an existing brand guide, understand the visual language, and develop new concepts that still feel unmistakably Great Stone Dragon.



Realistic mockups should also be created when appropriate so I can visualize how packaging, signage, printed materials, and other physical applications will look before production.



Final files should include editable source files whenever appropriate.



Work Style and Availability



This role is best suited for someone who is independent, proactive, organized, and reliable.



I do not want to micromanage every project or provide detailed instructions for every small design decision.



Once you understand the brand, I expect you to be able to:



• Take a general idea or request and develop it into a polished design

• Make thoughtful creative decisions independently

• Bring new ideas and suggestions to the brand

• Ask questions when something truly needs clarification

• Manage assigned projects without constant follow up

• Keep track of deadlines and priorities

• Communicate clearly about progress or potential delays

• Be responsive when projects or changes are needed



I am specifically looking for someone who can eventually understand my design preferences well enough that I do not need to explain the same likes, dislikes, or brand expectations repeatedly.



I want someone who can become a creative extension of the business rather than someone who only completes highly specific instructions.



PST Time Zone Availability



You must be able to work and communicate during Pacific Standard Time / Pacific Time business hours.



You do not necessarily need to live in the United States, but your schedule must overlap significantly with PST/Pacific Time so that communication, revisions, and projects can be handled efficiently.



There may occasionally be time sensitive projects, product launches, event materials, or updates that require relatively quick turnaround.



Because of this, I am looking for someone who is available and responsive when needed, within reasonable working expectations.



Consistent communication is extremely important for this position.



Existing Materials Provided



I will provide:



• Existing Great Stone Dragon brand guide

• Primary, secondary, badge, and icon logos

• Brand colors

• Brand fonts

• Existing patterns and graphics

• Current social media templates

• Existing packaging examples

• Previous design examples

• The Bold Heritage concept and visual direction I would like expanded



The existing identity should remain recognizable.



This project is about expanding, strengthening, and refining the brand rather than replacing it.



Ideal Designer



I am looking for someone with experience in:



• Brand identity application

• Graphic design

• Canva

• Packaging design

• Print collateral

• Ecommerce branding

• Social media design systems

• Product based small businesses

• Creating editable brand templates

• Preparing artwork correctly for professional printing

• Developing cohesive visual systems across multiple platforms



Experience with any of the following would be a major plus:



• Collectibles

• Enamel pins

• Stationery

• Luxury or premium packaging

• Fandom brands

• Boutique ecommerce brands

• Small business marketing

• Event or vendor booth branding



Ideal Personality and Working Style



The ideal person for this role is someone who:



• Is creative and brings new ideas rather than waiting for every idea to be provided

• Understands how to follow an established brand guide

• Has strong attention to detail

• Can take constructive feedback without losing creativity

• Learns my preferences over time

• Does not require constant supervision

• Can prioritize multiple design requests

• Communicates reliably

• Is responsive during Pacific Time working hours

• Can work independently while still collaborating when necessary

• Understands the importance of brand consistency

• Can balance creativity with practical business needs



Ultimately, I want the finished brand experience to make Great Stone Dragon feel like a fully developed collectible brand rather than simply a pin shop.



Every customer touchpoint, from receiving a bubble mailer, opening an order, seeing a vendor table, visiting the website, or scrolling past an Instagram post, should feel like part of the same recognizable Great Stone Dragon identity.

title: Cinematic Sports Documentary Editor — Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
Do not apply if your primary editing experience is Reels, TikTok, CapCut, or short-form social content.



We are looking for a high-level, fast-moving video editor who understands the storytelling and production quality behind Nike films, NFL Films, Netflix sports documentaries, athlete profiles, and premium YouTube documentaries.

Rare Blue Moon Marketing is a fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency, and we are hiring a full-time Cinematic Sports Documentary Editor to work primarily on a high-profile sports and athlete content account.



This is an opportunity for an editor who wants to produce serious, portfolio-level work on a consistent basis.

We are looking for someone who combines:

Cinematic quality + storytelling ability + SPEED.



You should be able to take interviews, B-roll, training footage, behind-the-scenes footage, archival content, and other raw assets and turn them into a compelling story — without needing someone to tell you where every cut should go.

Our ideal editor understands how to make a viewer feel something, while also working efficiently enough to perform in a fast-paced production environment.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT

You will primarily work on:

    •    Athlete profile documentaries

    •    Behind-the-scenes sports content

    •    Training and competition stories

    •    Brand documentary pieces

    •    Interview-driven documentaries

    •    Premium YouTube episodes

    •    10–40+ minute long-form content

    •    Supporting trailers, teasers, and promotional edits when needed



The standard we are working toward is closer to:

    •    NFL Films

    •    Netflix Sports

    •    Nike / Jordan Brand

    •    Premium athlete documentaries

    •    High-end YouTube documentary storytelling

    •    Not generic social media editing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

    •    Turn raw interviews and footage into compelling long-form stories

    •    Identify the strongest moments without relying on a producer to select every clip

    •    Build narrative arcs, emotional beats, tension, payoff, and pacing

    •    Edit polished 10–40+ minute documentary-style videos

    •    Create strong openings that immediately pull viewers into the story

    •    Incorporate cinematic B-roll, music, sound design, graphics, and archival footage

    •    Perform color correction and grading to create a polished, consistent look

    •    Clean and mix dialogue, music, ambient audio, and sound effects

    •    Collaborate with producers, directors, and videographers

    •    Organize large amounts of footage efficiently

    •    Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

    •    Turn around revisions quickly

    •    Maintain the same quality standard even when production moves fast



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a top performer.

Someone who is:

    •    Fast without becoming sloppy

    •    Highly organized

    •    Extremely responsive

    •    Strong at storytelling

    •    Detail-oriented

    •    Comfortable receiving feedback

    •    Able to make creative decisions independently

    •    Reliable with deadlines

    •    Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment

    •    Interested in improving constantly

    •    Able to work with minimal supervision



You should not need several days to make minor revisions.

You should not need constant follow-up to complete assignments.

You should be someone who takes ownership of the final product.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

    •    Proven long-form documentary or cinematic editing experience

    •    Portfolio containing real long-form work

    •    Strong understanding of narrative structure and storytelling

    •    Strong pacing instincts for 10+ minute videos

    •    Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve skills

    •    Strong sound design ability

    •    Strong music selection and music supervision instincts

    •    Color correction and grading experience

    •    Ability to work efficiently with large amounts of raw footage

    •    Excellent written and spoken English communication

    •    High responsiveness during working hours

    •    Ability to handle multiple deadlines

    •    Ability to work full-time and long-term



IMPORTANT:

Your portfolio must contain actual documentary-style or long-form storytelling work.

A portfolio consisting primarily of:

    •    Instagram Reels

    •    TikToks

    •    CapCut edits

    •    Highlight montages

    •    Trending transitions

    •    Short-form talking-head clips

will not qualify you for this position.



We care much more about your ability to tell a story than your ability to add flashy transitions.



BONUS POINTS

You will stand out if you have experience with:

    •    Athlete profile documentaries

    •    Professional or collegiate sports content

    •    Sports brands or athletic apparel companies

    •    YouTube documentary channels

    •    After Effects

    •    Motion graphics

    •    Cinematic title sequences

    •    Lower thirds and broadcast-style graphics

    •    Archival footage integration

    •    Large multi-shoot footage libraries

    •    
 or similar cloud-based review workflows



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

This is a fast-paced production environment.

We expect editors to:

    •    Meet agreed-upon deadlines consistently

    •    Communicate immediately if there is an issue

    •    Respond quickly during working hours

    •    Implement feedback accurately

    •    Work efficiently without sacrificing quality

    •    Stay organized across multiple projects

    •    Take ownership instead of waiting for constant direction

    •    Maintain a premium editing standard from project to project

Speed matters here — but quality matters just as much.

We are looking for editors who can deliver both.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This is not a position where you will spend all day creating disposable social clips.

You will have the opportunity to work on real athlete stories, documentary-style productions, and premium sports content with footage designed for cinematic storytelling.

For the right editor, this is a long-term position with consistent work, creative responsibility, and the opportunity to build an impressive body of sports documentary work.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications must be submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph.

Subject Line:

Cinematic Sports Documentary Editor – [Your Full Name]

Please include:

    •    Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

    •    Your Gmail address

    •    Links to 2–5 of your best long-form edits

    •    At least one complete documentary-style project whenever possible

    •    A brief explanation of the longest-form project you have edited

    •    Your specific role in shaping the story and narrative

    •    The editing software you primarily use

    •    Your typical turnaround time for a polished 10–20 minute video

    •    Your current availability and whether you are available full-time



Optional — But Strongly Encouraged:

Send a short Loom/video walking us through one of your best edits.

Explain:

    •    How you structured the story

    •    Why you made certain pacing decisions

    •    How you approached music and sound design

    •    How you built emotional moments

    •    What you personally contributed to the finished piece



BEFORE YOU APPLY

Ask yourself:

Can I take hours of raw footage and turn it into a story people actually want to finish?

Can I deliver premium work quickly without sacrificing quality?

Can I operate independently without someone managing every step of my editing process?

If the answer is yes, we want to see your work.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows editing software.

We are looking for a storyteller, an editor, and a high performer.

title: Manly Video Editor
description:
To be considered, please apply through this link: 



Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Experience: Minimum 2 years professional video editing



About Us




 is a fast-growing, direct-to-consumer personal care brand built for men who want products that actually work. We're scaling hard through performance creative — video ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and convert — and we're building out the in-house editing team that makes that happen.



We move fast, test constantly, and lean heavily on AI tools to produce more, better creative, faster. If you like a mix of craft and speed, this is your kind of team.



What We're Looking For



Manly is looking for a video editor who operates like a beast — not someone doing the bare minimum. We pay premium rates because we expect premium output. If you're looking for an easy gig, this isn't it. If you're someone who takes pride in your craft and wants to be paid like it, keep reading. What You'll Be Doing



- Producing 10 concepts per week as your standard output

- Editing across a range of high-performing ad formats: AI-generated ads, VSL (Video Sales Letters), UGC-style content, and more

- Working within a fast-paced creative pipeline, taking feedback and turning it around quickly

- Owning the quality of your edits from first cut to final delivery



Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of experience editing video, ideally in direct-response or performance marketing

- Comfortable and fast across AI, VSL, and UGC ad formats

- Strong storytelling and pacing instincts — you know what keeps someone watching

- Reliable, consistent, and able to hit weekly output targets without hand-holding

- Coachable — takes feedback and improves fast



Our Hiring Process



As part of our process, shortlisted candidates are asked to complete a short trial task before a final decision is made. This task is unpaid. If that's not something you're open to, that's completely fine — just let us know, no hard feelings. We just prioritize seeing real work in action wherever candidates are open to it.



Compensation



Base salary: competitive, paid to attract top-tier talent only.



Performance Bonus #1: Ad Spend Milestones (per ad)



Earn bonuses on any single ad based on how much spend it generates:



Ad Spend Reached: $15,000  | Bonus: $150   

Ad Spend Reached: $50,000  | Bonus: $250  

Ad Spend Reached: $100,000| Bonus: $500 



Hit all three milestones on one ad and you've earned $900 from that single ad alone.



Performance Bonus #2: Consistent Overperformance



Beat the standard target (more than 10 concepts/week) consistently for a full month, and your base salary increases by 50%, paid out in the second half of that month or by month-end.



Performance Bonus #3: Quarterly Bonus



An additional 10% of your annual base salary, distributed across the 4 quarters of the year, paid out monthly.



Who We Want



We don't want slackers. We don't want bare-minimum energy. We're paying premium rates because we want the best editors in the game, people who treat their output like it's their own brand, who move fast, who make ads that actually convert.

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO COMPLETE THE

FULL INSTRUCTIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED

- - - - - - - -

> Professionalism

• Deep understanding of troubleshooting Windows, networks, and cloud environments

• Ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently and efficiently

• Proficiency with:

-- ConnectWise Manage (PSA)

-- ConnectWise Asio / Automate (RMM)

-- IT Glue Documentation

-- Microsoft 365 Admin Centers (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams)

-- Entra ID / Azure AD (Identity, groups, MFA, SSO, access policies)

• Must demonstrate STRONG INTEGRITY, HONESTY, and ACCOUNTABILITY in all work





PREFERRED SKILLS (Bonus but not required)

• Experience with Intune, Endpoint Manager, M365 Compliance

• Experience with Ubiquiti hardware and cloud controllers

• Familiarity with IT Glue, Confluence, or ITBoost

• PowerShell scripting and command-line experience

• API/Webhook configuration experience

• Prior ConnectWise helpdesk experience (major plus)

• Vendor certifications (Microsoft, Cisco, SonicWall, Sophos, CompTIA)





CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

title: Video Editor D2C Food Brand (VSL, Short Form)
description:
Do you want to join a small team where your edits actually d
 whether the business grows and you get reward with bonuses on top of base salary?



Not a brand film nobody watches. Not a showreel piece. Ads that run real money behind them, where you find out every single week which of your cuts sold and which ones didn't.



That's this job.



Who we are:



We're a direct-to-consumer food brand. A large portion of our sales come from paid social, so the ads are the business. 



What you'll be doing:



You get a written brief with the script, the on-screen text and the format already worked out. You just need to source high quality clips and compile those clips into a seamless video for us to run.



Cut 5–10 ads a week from written briefs



Work in four formats: voiceover over b-roll, customer quotes on screen, silent text-only ads, and creator footage



Build on-screen text — headlines, captions, stat cards. In some of our ads the text is the ad



Cut for sound-off. Most people never turn the volume on



Make new versions of ads that are already working — new hooks, new openings



Join a short weekly call where we go through what won and what lost



Is this you?



You'll do well here if:



- You can genuinely edit — pacing, cuts, holding someone's attention

- You know Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or similar. We don't mind which

- You're fast and clean with on-screen text and simple motion graphics

- You can read a brief and get on with it

- You hit deadlines, and when you can't, we hear about it early

- Your English is good, written and spoken



Even better if:



- You've made ads meant to sell, not just look good

- You've worked on Meta ads

- You've worked with food, health or supplement brands



This probably isn't for you if:



- Your reel is beautiful but you've no idea whether any of it sold anything

- You want every step spelled out for you

- Revisions feel like criticism. The feedback loop is the job here

- You're already carrying two or three other full-time jobs. We need your focus, and we pay for it



How hiring works:



1 You fill in the form

2 Paid test edit — a real ad, paid at your hourly rate. We test a few people at the same time

3 Short video call — mostly us telling you more about the role

4 7 days paid trial on real work

5 Ongoing, on a salary paid weely



There's a bonus on top for ads that turn into winners, and we'll tell you exactly what counts as a winner before you start — so you always know what you're cutting toward.



Pay:



Weekly pay with bonuses for winning ads.



Want in?



Fill in the form below. No portfolio link, no reply.

title: DM Appointment Setter — US Real Estate — $2,000-$4,000/mo OTE
description:
DM APPOINTMENT SETTER — US REAL ESTATE INVESTING

$500/month base + 5% commission. Realistic $2,000-$4,000/month once ramped.

Full time. 10pm-7am Philippine time, Monday to Friday.



READ THIS FIRST



We have 1,400 people sitting in a free community who joined because they

want to invest in US property. Fourteen of them have ever been contacted.



Not fourteen percent. Fourteen people.



There are another 104 who had a real conversation with us months ago and

were never followed up. Thirteen of those told us they had $40,000 or more

ready to invest.



Nobody has messaged any of them. That is the entire job, and it is why this

role pays what it pays.



WHO WE ARE



We are a done-for-you property investment business based in Oklahoma, USA.

We buy, renovate, rent and refinance houses for investors who have capital

but no time to do it themselves.



Three years in the market. Around 70 properties owned outright. Over 200

completed alongside investors. We own the wholesale company, the general

contracting company and the title company, so the whole chain is in-house.



The founder has around 80,000 followers and runs a free 1,400-member

community. People watch hours of his content before they ever message us.

These are warm people. You are not cold-messaging strangers who have never

heard of us.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Open 200 new conversations a day across Instagram DMs,
 Messenger

  and our Skool community

- Send 100 follow-ups a day to conversations already open. The money is in

  the follow-up and we will not stop saying it

- Book 3 qualified calls a day once you are ramped

- Reply to every inbound DM within 15 minutes during your shift

- Work through the 1,400-member community and the 104-person dropped list

  systematically, not randomly

- Qualify properly: what have they actually implemented so far, what capital

  do they have, what is the timeline

- Book qualified people onto our closer's calendar

- Log every conversation, source and outcome in the CRM

- Send an end-of-day report every single working day



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- You do not pitch

- You do not quote a price. If asked, the answer is a $4,000 to $100,000

  range and "that is what the call is for"

- You do not close

- You do not tell anyone what returns they will make. Ever. This is a

  regulated-adjacent market and anyone who invents a number on a prospect

  is gone the same day



Your job is to start a conversation, qualify it honestly, and book it.

The closer does the rest.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Excellent written English. Natural, casual, human. Not stiff, not formal,

  not obviously copy-pasted. You will be writing as part of a US brand and

  prospects must not be able to tell the difference

- Real DM setting or appointment setting experience. Tell us the offer, the

  ticket price, and your actual numbers

- The ability to ask an American man about his money without going quiet.

  Half this job is finding out what capital someone actually has. Under

  $50,000 is not a rejection, it is a different offer — but you have to ask

- Willingness to work 10pm-7am Philippine time so you are awake when

  Americans are. This is not negotiable and it is the single most common

  reason we will say no

- This must be your only job. Not one of three clients. One

- Discipline to send an EOD report daily without being chased



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED



Property or real estate experience. Genuinely. We will train you on the

model in your first week and the honest thing to say on a message is "I am

not the one who analyses your deals, Alex does, that is what the call is

for." People respect that far more than a VA pretending to be an expert.



What you do need is someone who reads properly, because most of this job is

reading what a prospect actually wrote instead of what you assumed they

wrote. So include the word orange somewhere in your application. No

explanation needed. Just put it in.



THE MONEY, WITH THE ACTUAL MATHS



$500/month base, paid in any month you hit the standard.



5% of cash collected on every deal that closes from a call you set.



Our mentorship starts at $4,700. Our done-for-you packages have closed as

high as $45,000. The most recent one closed last week.



So what does that look like in practice:



- A slow month: 4 closes from your calls, mostly mentorship. Around $18,800

  collected. Your commission $940, plus $500 base = $1,440

- A normal month once you are ramped: 5 mentorship closes and one

  done-for-you client. Around $48,000 collected. Your commission $2,425,

  plus base = $2,925

- A strong month: two done-for-you clients in the mix. $4,000+



Your first month will not be your best month. Expect $800-$1,500 while you

learn the offer. We would rather tell you that now than have you disappointed

in week six.



Commission is paid on cash actually collected, not on contract value. If a

$45,000 client pays $25,000 up front, you are paid on the $25,000 now and on

the balance when the balance lands. Paid monthly via Wise.



One rule worth knowing before you apply: a booking only pays the full 5% if

you sent the confirmation text and the pre-call resources afterwards. Skip

that step and the same booking pays 2.5%. The step that makes people show up

is the step that pays you.



HOW WE ACTUALLY RUN



Week one is training and you do not touch a live prospect until you have

passed a fifteen-minute debrief where you explain our offer back to us in

your own words, list the top ten objections with the approved responses, and

show us three messages you have written in our voice.



After that you are live, your conversations are reviewed daily for the first

week, and we run a day-five review.



You will have scripts, a follow-up ladder, saved replies, call recordings to

learn from, and a manager who reviews your work rather than just asking for

numbers. What you will not have is anyone chasing you to do your dials.



HOW TO APPLY



Two things. Applications missing either are not read.



1. Write the exact first DM you would send to this person, word for word:



   "Someone joined our free community seven months ago. They have watched

   almost every video. They have never done a deal. They are a little

   embarrassed about that."



   Do not describe what you would say. Write the actual message, exactly as

   you would send it. This is the most important part of your application

   and it is the thing we score hardest.



2. Record a 2-3 minute video, camera on, and paste the link (Loom, Google

   Drive, anything). Tell us who you are, one thing you are genuinely good

   at in a DM conversation, and your best month in a setting role and what

   produced it.



We reply to every application within 48 hours, yes or no. How fast you reply

to us is how we predict how fast you will reply to a prospect, so treat this

as the first test, because it is.

title: Amazon Marketplace Operations Specialist | Seller Central, FBA & Logistics
description:

s and routine customer questions

title: Cosmetic Formulation Chemist (Remote, Part-Time) — Skincare R&D Support
description:
About the role



US-based cosmetic R&D lab seeking an experienced chemist or chemical engineer to support formulation development for indie skincare brands. This is technical/advisory work. You will not be making samples. We have a lab in the US and produce all bench samples here. You provide the diagnosis, the formula recommendations, and the documentation. We execute and report results back to you with data.



What you'll do



Review client formulas and diagnose stability, texture, and performance failures

Recommend formula adjustments with specific ingredients and use levels, and explain the reasoning

Develop new formulations to client criteria (plant-based, preservative restrictions, cost targets)

Write and review specs, TDS, and SDS documentation

Design stability and QC protocols; interpret results we send you from the bench

Identify raw materials and suppliers using UL Prospector



Product categories: skincare, body care, anhydrous systems (butters, balms, oils), emulsions, surfactant cleansers. No sunscreen. No color cosmetics.



Required



PRC Registered Chemist (RCh) or licensed Chemical Engineer — please include your license number

5+ years in personal care or pharmaceutical R&D, QC, or technical services

Hands-on experience designing and interpreting stability protocols and challenge testing

Strong written English; you will be writing recommendations clients read

Able to work from bench data (pH, viscosity, phase behavior, stability readings) rather than from touching the product.



Preferred



Emulsion and anhydrous system troubleshooting

Scale-up experience (jacketed tanks, cooling rates, mixing)

PIF authoring under the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive

Natural/plant-based formulation and alternative preservation systems

title: Remote Inventory & Pricing Coordinator (+ Vendor Management & PA Support)
description:
This is a hybrid full-time remote role for someone who can wear multiple hats and take real ownership. Your core focus is managing inventory and pricing — sourcing and negotiating with suppliers, tracking stock, and questioning vendor bills that look off. Alongside that, you'll also handle day-to-day personal/admin support tasks. We're not looking for someone who just executes a checklist — we want someone who thinks like it's their own business and pushes back on bad pricing or bad vendors without being asked.



Responsibilities

* Open new accounts with suppliers/vendors and manage onboarding paperwork

* Source and compare suppliers; negotiate pricing and terms

* Track inventory levels and flag reorder needs before we run out

* Review recurring vendor bills (utilities, waste management, service contracts) and proactively question and negotiate charges that look off or have crept up

* Pull commercial real estate comps and listings using our existing platform accounts to support site/leasing decisions

* Handle personal assistant tasks: scheduling,
/inbox management, research, booking, general admin

* Handle ad hoc research and admin projects as they come up

* Use AI tools to speed up research and drafting, but always verify before anything goes to a vendor or gets acted on



Requirements

* Proven experience with inventory management and/or pricing (ask for a specific example)

* Proven experience negotiating with vendors/suppliers

* Comfortable making outbound calls to vendors — this isn't a desk-only role

* Strong written English and organizational skills

* Self-starter who doesn't need hand-holding on prioritization



Nice to Have

* Experience with commercial accounts (utilities, waste management, facility vendors)

* Familiarity with commercial real estate research/comps

* Prior PA or executive assistant experience



When Applying, Include:

1. A specific example of managing inventory or negotiating a vendor bill down

2. Your comfort level making phone calls to vendors

3. Your expected monthly rate

title: AI Image Designer (ChatGPT + Canva) – Premium Spiritual Wellness Brand
description:
At Anima we sell spiritual tools that create a spark: crystal sets, incense and candles that open your eyes to what is already inside you. The products are a catalyst; the person is the creator. We sell on Amazon in the US, UK, Germany and Canada, our own store is launching, and we are a fast-growing e-commerce company that runs on AI. Image quality is the heart of the brand.



If you are interested in spirituality, meditation and crystals, and you care about this kind of product, you will fit here better than someone who only sees a picture to make.



THE JOB



You turn briefs into finished, on-brand images with AI. Our Lead Creative Strategist gives you the product, the angle, the message, example copy and reference photos of the real product. You generate the image in ChatGPT, make the product in the picture exactly the product we ship, retouch and finish it in Canva, set the copy on it, and deliver files ready to publish.



Today most of the work is Amazon listing images and A+ content. Website, ads, social, packaging and new product lines come next, and they all need the same thing from you: a finished image with the right words on it. You do not d
 what gets made or write the brief. You own the craft.



Anima runs on AI systems. Our brand rules, product facts and procedures live in a company AI you are connected to from day one, and our AI agents help you get the wording and direction of each image right before you generate. The system gives you the what; you bring the how.



You are measured on three numbers we share with you every month: on-time delivery (you set the date, you hit it, target 95%), first-pass approval (approved with one round of notes or none, target 75% within six months), and output (finished files delivered).



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Experience making AI images that sell. The one thing we care about most. You have produced AI imagery for e-commerce or retail brands, for products that were actually sold, not AI art because it looks beautiful. You can show three pieces and explain exactly how you made each one.

- Product and model fidelity. We make images that do not look like AI images. The product must be exactly the product we ship, and any person in the frame must look real. If you cannot get the product right, nothing else matters.

- ChatGPT and Canva, fast in both. Every image is retouched and finished by hand: fidelity, colour, cleanup, layout, type. Photoshop is fine for parts of it; Canva is where the team works.

- Excellent written English. Not good, excellent. You write the words that go on the picture, so a headline from you reads like a native copywriter wrote it. We read your application as your first English test.

- You hold a brand. Ten images from you look like one company made them.



WHO YOU ARE



Ambitious. You work hard and you go beyond what was asked. Optimistic and joyful to work with. Smart enough to understand feedback the first time and apply it the next, not argue it. You ask questions before you start, not after you deliver.



A strong plus: you have lived, studied or worked outside the Philippines, worked closely with Western brands and teams, or travelled widely. Our customers are in the US and Europe, and people with that exposure fit the team faster.



PAY AND SCHEDULE



- USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month depending on experience, paid monthly. Reviewed against your KPIs; consistently hitting them earns bonuses tied to those KPIs.

- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day, with fixed overlap 2:00 pm to 6:00 pm Philippine time alongside our team in Europe and Bangkok.

- Full-time independent contractor. Start as soon as possible, three-month probation. We pay for your ChatGPT and Canva Pro.

- You report to our Lead Creative Strategist.



HOW WE HIRE



1. A 30-minute video call in English with our CEO.

2. A test task from a real brief: two to four hours, 48-hour turnaround, unpaid. It is the same work as the job, and it is how we choose.

3. A final call with our CMO and Lead Creative Strategist: your test, scope, pay, start date.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word AMETHYST.

2. Send three AI-generated product or e-commerce images you made. For at least one, include the prompt and the raw output next to the finished file.

3. Look at 
 (our Energy Cleansing Set). In three or four sentences, tell us which image you would redo first and why.

4. Tell us your available hours in Philippine time.



Applications missing any of the four will not be reviewed.

title: Finance & Inventory Analyst
description:
About Apex Sports

Apex Sports makes portable at-home training equipment for volleyball, baseball, soccer and lacrosse. We bring the court to your backyard, driveway or home. We're a fast-growing, remote-first team selling on Amazon US, Amazon Canada and Shopify, shipping 50+ containers a year from our factory partner in China.

We run lean and automate before we hire. Most of our operations run through a custom-built Ops App and a library of Claude skills. This role exists because the work below is real, recurring and finally big enough to deserve one owner.



The role

You keep the numbers true and the inventory moving. Three parts: you close the books each month, you operate our demand-planning system, and you execute supply-chain paperwork for our COO. You're the person who notices when a number is wrong before anyone else does.



What you'll own

Monthly close (~40%)

• Close the books in QuickBooks Online by the 7th of each month, for two entities in USD and CAD

• Reconcile every bank and card account: BMO, Wise, Mercury, five Amex cards, PayPal

• Verify A2X settlement postings for Amazon US and CA; book Shopify, Walmart, Etsy and PayPal revenue

• Post landed cost per purchase order (product, freight, duty, broker, 3PL inbound) to QBO and to our SKU unit economics

• Audit vendor invoices against quotes: freight forwarder, customs broker, 3PL, Amazon fee changes

• File Amazon FBA reimbursement claims monthly: lost and damaged inventory, fee overcharges, returns not received

• Prepare the quarterly package and sales-tax exports (GST/HST, US state) for our external CPA

Demand planning operations (~30%)

• Operate the reorder model in our Ops App: keep sales velocity, lead times and stock stages accurate

• Run the weekly reorder review; flag every order-by date at least 3 weeks before it passes

• Draft suggested purchase orders with costing for approval

• Keep the cash projection in sync with PO payment schedules and wires sent

• Maintain data integrity across the app: PO decisions closed out, supplier records clean, SKU specs complete



Supply-chain execution for the COO (~30%)

• Create FBA shipment plans in Seller Central once quantities are approved

• Run our shipment skills: carton-label splitting, shipment bundles, pickup and freight-quote
s

• Follow up with our factory in China on production status and pickup readiness during their working hours

• Send customs documents to the broker; book inbound with the 3PL; update shipment records

• Track ETAs and flag delays against the reorder plan



What you won't own

• Approving purchase orders or d
 order quantities (CEO and COO)

• Sending wires or holding bank authority (CEO)

• Negotiating with suppliers or freight partners (CEO and COO)

• Tax filings and year-end statements (external CPA — you prepare, they file)

• Sales and marketing reporting (Marketing & Operations Assistant)

You record, reconcile, prepare and flag. Decisions stay with the people accountable for them.



What we're looking for:



Must have

• 3+ years bookkeeping for an e-commerce or inventory-based business, with month-end close ownership

• Daily QuickBooks Online user; A2X or equivalent marketplace settlement tool

• Amazon Seller Central experience: FBA shipments, settlement reports, reimbursement claims

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets; comfortable with COGS, landed cost and multi-currency

• Comfortable working with Claude or similar AI tools daily — you'll operate and improve our skill library

• Written English clear enough to
 a customs broker or freight forwarder unsupervised

• Available 4+ hours overlapping Pacific time (mornings PT), plus flexibility for China-hours follow-up



Nice to have

• Canadian GST/HST or US sales-tax prep experience

• Multi-entity books with intercompany transactions

• Demand planning, reorder-point or inventory-forecasting experience

• Sellerboard, Scale Insights, Shopify or Walmart Seller Center

Who does well here



You like clean data and get uneasy when something doesn't tie out. You'd rather build a checklist than remember a step. You ask one clear question instead of five vague ones. You say "this looks wrong" before anyone asks. In your
 application, please start the
 with "Apex Rocks" so we know you read the entire application. 



How we work

Location: Remote, Philippines

Type: Full-time independent contractor

Reports to: CEO for finance; COO for demand planning and supply chain

Hours: 40 hrs/week; at least 4 hrs overlapping 8 AM–2 PM Pacific Time

Compensation: USD $–/month depending on experience, paid semi-monthly

Start: As soon as possible; 90-day probation



We're a small, high-trust team. Hours are flexible; being switched on is not. Nobody watches your clock, but if a wire needs recording or a shipment needs chasing, you're on it. You'll get written SOPs and Loom walkthroughs for every recurring process, and you'll be expected to improve them.

All financial information you handle is confidential.



How to apply

Send a short note (not a cover letter) with your CV to 
 covering:

1. One month-end close you owned: how many accounts, what went wrong, how you fixed it

2. Your QuickBooks Online and Seller Central experience, in two sentences each

3. How you use AI tools in your work today



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid 2-hour scenario test: reconcile a sample statement set into QBO, identify the reimbursement claims in a sample FBA report, and run one of our shipment skills from its SOP with a real shipment ID.

title: AI-Native Client Success & Sales Operations Manager
description:
About Elite Careers Strategy



Elite Careers Strategy (ECS) is a London-based private advisory working with a small number of clients and families internationally on highly competitive careers in corporate law, investment banking, private equity and related fields.



We are looking for an exceptional Client Success & Sales Operations Manager to work directly with the founder.



This is not a basic VA role.



You will own the operational journey of prospects and clients: making sure leads are followed up, opportunities do not go cold, clients receive excellent communication, commitments are tracked, and the founder is brought in when his judgement is actually required.



We are an AI-native company. You must already be an excellent user of modern AI tools and be able to use them intelligently in real work.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Responding to and following up new enquiries

* Nurturing and qualifying prospective clients

* Re-engaging strong prospects who have gone quiet

* Preparing prospects for calls with the founder

* Tracking every prospect and ensuring there is a clear next action

* Maintaining accurate CRM records

* Following up actions from meetings,
s and messages

* Coordinating onboarding and routine client administration

* Proactively checking in with clients

* Tracking client requests, deadlines and outstanding commitments

* Identifying problems before they become problems

* Escalating high-consequence or judgement-sensitive matters to the founder

* Using AI to make the above dramatically faster and more reliable

* Helping improve and automate repeatable workflows over time



AI capability is essential.



We do not mean simply knowing how to use ChatGPT.



You should be able to use tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to research, synthesise information, prepare briefings, draft communications, extract actions from meetings, analyse pipeline information, identify inconsistencies, improve workflows and quality-control your work.



You should understand that AI can make mistakes. You must know when to verify something yourself, when automation is appropriate and when a decision should be escalated to a human.



You do not need to be a programmer.



You may be an excellent fit if:



* Your written English is exceptional

* You are extremely reliable and detail-oriented

* You naturally follow things through without being chased

* You have strong judgement and common sense

* You communicate professionally with demanding clients

* You are commercially minded without being pushy

* You notice inconsistencies and mistakes

* You learn new software very quickly

* You are already a sophisticated AI user

* You enjoy taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions



Experience in customer success, sales operations, account management, recruitment, professional services, executive search, education/admissions or another high-trust client environment is particularly relevant.



Important: This role involves confidential client information. Accuracy, discretion and information security are essential.



To apply



Please begin your application with the words “ECS CLIENT SUCCESS” so we know you have read the full description.



Then answer these five questions:



1. Tell me about the most sophisticated way you currently use AI in your work. Be specific about the tools and workflow.

2. A prospective client has had a strong first call with our founder but has not replied for seven days. What would you do?

3. You notice our CRM says a client owes money, but another record suggests they may already have paid. What would you do before contacting the client?

4. Give one example of something important you took ownership of without being repeatedly instructed by your manager.

5. What is one business task you would not allow AI to complete autonomously, and why?



Please also include:



* your CV or LinkedIn profile

* your current working situation

* your availability in UK working hours

* your expected monthly compensation

* which AI tools you use regularly



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical exercise based on realistic ECS prospect and client scenarios.



⸻



There will be a bonus component as part of this role.

title: DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist - PH based
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!
