title: Video Editor | Premium Business & Personal Brand Content
description:
Elite Careers Strategy is a London-based private advisory working with ambitious candidates and families pursuing careers in corporate law, investment banking, private equity and other highly selective industries.



We are looking for an excellent Video Editor to take ownership of our video content.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to use Premiere Pro or CapCut. We want someone with strong editorial judgement who understands pacing, storytelling, retention and premium brand presentation.



You will primarily edit founder-led educational and thought-leadership content for YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram and other social platforms.



What you will do



* Turn raw founder footage into polished long-form YouTube videos

* Produce high-retention short-form clips for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and TikTok

* Identify the strongest moments from longer recordings without needing every clip timestamped for you

* Remove repetition, pauses, weak sections and unnecessary material

* Create strong opening hooks while preserving the founder’s actual meaning

* Add clean captions, graphics, screenshots, B-roll and visual emphasis where useful

* Improve pacing and viewer retention without making serious professional content feel gimmicky

* Repurpose one recording intelligently across multiple platforms

* Maintain consistent ECS visual and editorial standards

* Organise source footage, project files and final exports properly

* Use AI tools where they genuinely improve editing speed or quality



The style we want



Think premium, intelligent, understated and authoritative.



Our audience includes students and young professionals, but also parents, senior professionals, private bankers and other sophisticated audiences.



We do not want excessive animations, meme editing, constant zooms, unnecessary sound effects or the generic over-edited “internet guru” aesthetic.

title: Senior Paid Media Strategist (Digital Media Buyer)
description:
LN & Co. is a multicultural digital marketing agency based in Silver Spring, Maryland. Our clients are churches, nonprofits, advocacy organizations, education groups and B2B companies, and the campaigns we run help people find jobs, housing, training and communities to belong to. When one of our ads performs, there is usually a real person on the other end of it whose life got a little better.



We are looking for a senior paid media strategist to lead that work. You will own strategy, account builds, optimization, and client reporting across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, and TikTok, plus Google Ad Grant accounts for our nonprofit partners. The media decisions are yours, and our Director of Technology and Paid Media works alongside you on tracking, sites and automation.



WHERE YOUR EXPERTISE SHINES:

A lot of our work lives inside Special Ad Categories. The strategists who do their best work here have mastered those rules and know how to build campaigns that perform within them. Our team and our clients will count on you as the expert who gets it right from the start. You will bring a working command of:



Meta's four Special Ad Categories, including the move from Credit to Financial Products and Services for US campaigns in January 2025



Rebuilding reach once a category removes ZIP codes, lookalikes, age, gender and audience exclusions



Advertiser verification and "Paid for by" disclaimers for Social Issues, Elections or Politics ads



Google's personalized advertising policy for housing, employment and credit



LinkedIn's advertiser certification for employment, housing, education and credit, and TikTok's HEC policy for US and Canadian audiences



Google Ad Grants compliance, from the 5 percent account CTR floor and quality score rules to conversion tracking and Smart Bidding



WHAT YOU BRING:

Six or more years in paid media, with at least three of them owning strategy on senior accounts.



Hands-on experience with US audiences and US clients.



Written English strong enough to send reports and recommendations straight to a client, and the presence to lead a client call.



Confidence in regulated and mission-driven advertising, including faith, advocacy and nonprofit work.



Fluency in GA4 and platform reporting, and a gift for turning numbers into a story a board member or funder can follow.



Flexible Working hours between 8am to 4pm US Eastern 



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

You will audit every active account for Special Ad Category exposure, get our Ad Grant accounts running steadily above the CTR floor, and set the reporting format the whole roster uses. From there, we build growth targets for each account together.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to 
 with "Paid Media" in the subject line, along with short written answers (200 words or less each) to these two questions:



A nonprofit client runs a job training program and a housing counseling program from one Meta ad account and wants both promoted this quarter. How would you structure it, and what targeting changes in each case?

A Google Ad Grant account closed last month at 3.1 percent CTR. What would you do in your first week, and in what order?



Let us know where you are based and the hours you can work against US Eastern. Applications that include both answers go straight to the hiring team.

title: AI Video Creator / Video Editor (5-10 Videos per week)
description:
**AI Video Creator / Video Editor**



We’re looking for a creative video maker who can combine AI tools with strong editing skills to produce content that grabs attention, looks polished and drives action.



You’ll take ideas from concept through to finished video, creating social media ads, product videos, website content and short-form organic content across our brands.



You should have a strong eye for design, a feel for storytelling and a clear understanding of what makes people stop scrolling.



**What you’ll do**



* Turn briefs, product information and rough ideas into compelling video concepts, scripts and storyboards.

* Create AI visuals, video clips, voiceovers and animation, maintaining consistent characters, products and branding.

* Combine AI assets with real footage, product photography, screen recordings, music and motion graphics.

* Edit videos with strong hooks, clear messaging, tight pacing, captions and effective calls to action.

* Produce multiple versions of creative, testing different openings, angles, lengths and offers.

* Adapt videos for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and websites, keeping text and key visuals within placement safe zones.

* Use feedback and campaign results to improve future creatives.

* Keep project files and assets organised so work can be updated and reused easily.



**What we’re looking for**



* A strong portfolio of video editing and AI-assisted video work.

* Confident use of professional editing software and AI image, video and audio tools.

* Excellent judgement around composition, typography, colour, sound and pacing.

* The ability to turn generated assets into a cohesive, professional final video.

* An understanding of social advertising, including hooks, benefits, objections and calls to action.

* Attention to detail, including spotting visual glitches, inconsistent products, unnatural movement and caption errors.

* Someone who takes initiative, contributes ideas and delivers reliably.

* Good judgement when sourcing footage, music, voices and likenesses, with appropriate usage rights.



**Bonus experience**



* Creating ads for ecommerce products or service businesses.

* Motion graphics, compositing and product animation.

* Writing scripts and developing creative concepts.

* Using ad performance data to d
 what to test next.

* Building repeatable production workflows without making every video look the same.



**What success looks like**



A steady output of distinctive, on-brand videos delivered on time, with fresh ideas and variations that help us learn what captures attention and converts. You’ll balance production speed with quality and take ownership from the initial idea through to final export.



**To apply**



Send us:



* A short introduction and your availability.

* Your CV or a summary of relevant experience.

* Three to five relevant video examples, including AI-assisted work.

* A brief explanation of your contribution and the tools used for each example.

* Your salary expectations or freelance rates.



Your portfolio and creative judgement matter more to us than formal qualifications.

title: Real Estate Agent Support & Coaching Coordinator | Full-Time Remote
description:
Real Estate Agent Support & Coaching Coordinator | Full-Time Remote



Realty ONE Group MVP is one of Florida’s largest and fastest-growing real estate brokerages. We support more than 1,100 real estate agents with modern technology, professional coaching, and a strong operational infrastructure.



We are hiring a full-time Real Estate Agent Support & Coaching Coordinator to manage the routine, repeatable work behind our agent support and coaching programs.



This is not a passive
-forwarding position.



This is an active coordination role for someone who can organize incoming requests, identify priorities, maintain multiple trackers and calendars, and keep assignments moving without constant supervision.



You must also recognize when something falls outside your authority and escalate it instead of guessing.



Position Overview



You will help manage our agent support inbox, coordinate coaching program logistics, and maintain onboarding, attendance, and performance trackers.



You will use approved templates for agent-facing communication and follow documented procedures for routing and escalating requests.



You will not be responsible for resolving complex agent complaints, answering legal or compliance questions, making policy decisions, or creating coaching curriculum. Your responsibility is to organize, track, communicate, follow up, and escalate when a decision is required.



Key Responsibilities



Agent Support Coordination



- Monitor the agent support inbox during assigned working hours.

- Review, tag, categorize, and route incoming requests to the correct person or department.

- Identify urgent or time-sensitive requests and escalate them promptly.

- Send initial responses using approved templates.

- Never create independent responses to sensitive, complex, or unclear issues.

- Maintain a tracker of open, pending, escalated, and resolved support requests.

- Follow up on unresolved items to prevent requests from being overlooked.

- Prepare a weekly summary of the most common agent questions and support issues.



Coaching Program Coordination



- Manage registrations for coaching programs, webinars, and training sessions.

- Create and send calendar invitations.

- Send reminders using approved communication templates.

- Track enrollment, attendance, completion, and participation.

- Update coaching scorecards and prepare raw data for leadership review.

- Maintain accurate coaching records in our CRM and internal databases.

- Follow up with participants regarding missing forms, registrations, or required information.

- Keep coaching calendars organized and current.



Agent Onboarding Support



- Maintain and update new-agent onboarding trackers.

- Confirm that new agents receive access to required systems before their scheduled start date.

- Identify missing onboarding steps and route them to the appropriate department.

- Track outstanding onboarding items through completion.

- Maintain accurate records of onboarding progress.

- Escalate delays or access problems that require leadership involvement.



Training and Administrative Support



- Maintain event registrations and attendance lists.

- Organize training schedules and program calendars.

- Format internal documents, checklists, procedures, and playbooks as directed.

- Keep shared folders, templates, and records organized.

- Assist with other clearly defined administrative projects related to agent support, coaching, and onboarding.



How Performance Will Be Measured



This is a scorecard-driven position. Your performance will be reviewed weekly based on:



- Number of support requests categorized and routed.

- Response and routing turnaround time.

- Accuracy when using approved response templates.

- Number of responses requiring corrections.

- Coaching registrations and attendance entered on time.

- Accuracy of coaching and onboarding trackers.

- Completion of scheduled follow-ups.

- Weekly reports submitted correctly and on time.

- Number of open items aging beyond established deadlines.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have experience in customer support, administrative coordination, scheduling, real estate administration, or program coordination.

- Write clearly and professionally in English.

- Are comfortable communicating with customers or professionals through
.

- Can manage multiple trackers, inboxes, calendars, and deadlines at the same time.

- Are proactive and follow up without needing repeated reminders.

- Can prioritize urgent requests without ignoring routine responsibilities.

- Understand the importance of following approved templates and procedures.

- Know when to escalate an issue instead of making an unauthorized decision.

- Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently after training.

- Take pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Requirements



- Previous experience in customer support, administrative assistance, scheduling, event coordination, program coordination, or real estate support.

- Strong written English communication.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Experience using calendars, spreadsheets, task trackers, or CRM systems.

- Ability to follow SOPs, templates, and escalation procedures.

- Full-time availability, Monday through Friday.

- Availability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Reliable high-speed internet.

- Reliable computer and quiet home workspace.

- Comfortable learning new CRM, helpdesk, calendar, and database systems.

- Willing to have productivity and accuracy measured through a weekly scorecard.

- No conflicting full-time position.



What We Provide



- A clearly defined role with documented responsibilities.

- Approved communication templates and internal playbooks.

- Training on our systems, procedures, and escalation rules.

- Direct access to department leaders when an issue requires escalation.

- Consistent full-time work with a stable and growing U.S. real estate brokerage.

- The opportunity to develop valuable experience in real estate support, coaching operations, and agent onboarding.

- Long-term growth opportunities for someone who is dependable, organized, and committed.



Why Join Realty ONE Group MVP?



You will be joining one of Florida’s largest and fastest-growing real estate brokerages while we continue building our agent support and coaching infrastructure for the long term.



This is an opportunity to become the person who keeps two highly visible departments organized and moving forward. Your work will allow our support and coaching leaders to spend more time helping agents while you make sure the systems, calendars, communications, and follow-ups remain accurate.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume.



2. A brief explanation of your experience with customer support, scheduling, administrative coordination, real estate support, or coaching program logistics.



3. Your answers to the following questions:



- What three tools have you used for CRM, customer support, task management, or calendar coordination?

- Describe a time you had several competing priorities in one day. How did you d
 what needed to be handled first?

- How would you handle a request that falls outside your authority or knowledge?

- How do you make sure follow-ups and unresolved requests do not get forgotten?

- Are you available to work full-time with overlap during U.S. Eastern Time business hours?

- What is your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos?



4. Attach or provide a link to one relevant work sample. This could be a tracker, calendar, checklist, customer-support template, report, or similar administrative example. Please remove all confidential information before submitting it.



Applications that do not answer every question may not be considered.



Please begin your application with the words “Agent Support” so we know you read the entire posting.



Job Type: Full-time  

Work Location: Remote  

Schedule: Monday through Friday with U.S. Eastern Time overlap

 is looking for a highly tech-savvy individual to join our growing team. This is not a typical Virtual Assistant position. title: LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement Specialist
description:
About Founders & Funders



Founders & Funders is a growing community that brings together high-potential founders, venture capital firms, and strategic partners through curated events, meaningful introductions, and relationship-driven experiences. We are looking for an experienced **LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement** who can help us identify, engage, and invite the right founders to our events.



This is not simply a high-volume outreach role. We need someone who understands how to find qualified founders, create communications that feel personal and relevant, and build outreach systems that consistently generate strong responses and event registrations.



What You’ll Own



Founder Research and Targeting

- Identify founders who match the specific criteria, audience, and goals of each event.

- Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, databases, AI tools, and other research platforms.

- Evaluate founder quality based on factors such as company stage, revenue, funding, industry, location, and overall event fit.

- Continuously improve targeting strategies based on registration quality and campaign performance.



LinkedIn Outreach and Engagement

- Create personalized LinkedIn outreach campaigns that capture founders’ attention and encourage meaningful responses.

- Write creative invitations, follow-ups, and engagement sequences that feel warm, relevant, and human.

- Adapt messaging for different founder segments, industries, funding stages, and event formats.

- Engage prospects through both automated and manual outreach while maintaining a high level of personalization.

- Build genuine relationships with founders—not simply send connection requests or generic messages.



Automation, AI, and Campaign Systems

- Use LinkedIn outreach and automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools to build and manage campaigns.

- Use AI strategically for research, personalization, message development, segmentation, and campaign optimization.

- Create repeatable outreach workflows that allow the team to scale without sacrificing message quality.

- Monitor platform limitations and LinkedIn best practices to maintain account safety and campaign effectiveness.

- Test new tools, systems, and approaches that can improve founder acquisition.



Lead Generation and Performance

- Own outreach performance from prospect identification through registration.

- Track key metrics such as connection acceptance, response rate, qualified conversations, registrations, approvals, and attendance.

- Run regular message and campaign tests to improve results.

- Identify why campaigns are performing well or underperforming and recommend solutions.

- Provide clear updates on results, challenges, learnings, and next steps.



What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience in LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, founder acquisition, business development, or a related role.

- Advanced knowledge of LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Experience using LinkedIn automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of outreach automation, AI-assisted workflows, CRM systems, and lead-generation platforms.

- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create communications that are engaging, personalized, and not overly sales-driven.

- Experience building and optimizing multi-step outreach campaigns.

- Strong research skills and the ability to distinguish qualified prospects from high-volume lists.

- Comfortable working with performance metrics and making decisions based on campaign data.

- Highly organized, resourceful, proactive, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once.

- Strong judgment when balancing automation with thoughtful, human engagement.



What Success Looks Like

title: Social Media & Creative Content Coordinator
description:
Soil Wizards Lawn & Pest Control



Soil Wizards isn't your typical lawn and pest control company, and we have absolutely no interest in becoming one.



We're building a brand around science, personality, education, creativity, and a little bit of magic.



At the center of it all is Wizzroot, our wizard and the soul of the Soil Wizards brand.



We're looking for a creative, energetic Social Media & Creative Content Coordinator who can help bring Wizzroot and the Soil Wizards world to life across Instagram,
, and whatever platform we d
 to conquer next.



Your Mission

You'll help manage the day-to-day social presence of Soil Wizards while turning lawn care and pest control into content people actually want to see. Yes. Pest control.

If you can make chinch bugs, termites, Florida lawns, soil health, and Wizzroot entertaining, you're exactly the kind of person we're looking for.



You'll help create easy-to-use branded templates and use an established brand guidelines, but we want you to bring ideas to the table.



This isn't a role for someone who just schedules posts. We want creativity. We want personality. We want fun.



What You'll Be Doing

- Manage and maintain Soil Wizards' presence on Instagram,
, and future social platforms.

- Create posts, stories, reels, graphics, and other social content.

- Use, create and customize our whimsical branded templates.

- Help develop new & reusable templates and content concepts.

- Write clear, fun, fluent English captions that actually sound human.

- Bring Wizzroot into educational, entertaining, seasonal, and promotional content.

- Turn real pest control and lawn-care knowledge into simple, engaging content.

- Highlight customer reviews, transformations, services, team moments, and company wins.

- Brainstorm creative campaigns around holidays, Florida weather, pests, lawns, and seasonal problems.

- Help maintain a consistent visual identity and voice across every platform.

- Keep an eye on comments, messages, trends, and opportunities to engage with the community.

- Help us experiment with new platforms and content formats as the brand grows.



The Soil Wizards Voice



Our content should feel whimsical, clever, helpful, scientific, local, and fun. We aren't trying to scare homeowners into buying pest control. We want to spark joy while teaching people something useful.



Wizzroot may be magical, but the methods behind Soil Wizards are grounded in real lawn and pest-control science. That balance is incredibly important. Magic gets their attention. Science earns their trust.



You Might Be Our Person If...



Creativity and fun are REQUIRED for this role.



You should also:

- Be fluent in written and spoken English.

- Have excellent spelling and grammar.

- Understand Instagram and
 beyond simply posting a picture.

- Be comfortable creating content in Canva.

- Have a strong eye for clean, simple design.

- Understand that design comes first and copy supports it.

- Be able to take a brand personality and consistently build around it.

- Enjoy brainstorming weird, clever, unexpected ideas.

- Be willing to learn about lawn care, pests, soil health, and Florida-specific problems.

- Be organized enough to follow a content calendar without killing the creativity.

- Be comfortable receiving feedback and quickly making adjustments.

- Understand that consistency matters just as much as one great post.



Bonus Points

Experience with short-form video and Reels.

CapCut or similar video editing tools.

Meta Business Suite.

Social media analytics.

Photography or videography.

AI-assisted creative tools.

Local service businesses.

Lawn care, landscaping, pest control, or home services.

Community engagement and responding to comments.

Building recognizable characters or mascot-driven brands.



What We DON'T Want

We're not looking for someone who copies a generic pest-control post, changes the logo, and calls it content.

We're not interested in endless stock photos with paragraphs of text slapped on top.

And we're definitely not trying to make Soil Wizards look like every other lawn and pest company on
.

Wizzroot has a personality. Soil Wizards has a world.

Your job is to help us keep building it.



What Success Looks Like

Success isn't just "we posted three times this week."

We want people to start recognizing Soil Wizards content before they even see our logo.

We want homeowners to learn something.

We want customers to smile.

We want people to remember Wizzroot.

And ultimately, we want social media to help turn attention into trust and trust into customers.



To Apply

Don't just send us a résumé. Show us something you've created.

Send us examples of social posts, graphics, videos, brands, or creative projects you've worked on.



Then answer one question:

If Wizzroot discovered a massive fire ant mound in someone's backyard, what would you post about it? There isn't one correct answer. We just want to see how your brain works. Bring the creativity. We'll teach you the magic.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – Luxury Travel & Hotels (Reels/TikTok/Shorts) – Part-Time
description:
I'm Jasmine, a luxury travel and hospitality 
 film hotels, historic properties and destinations, and I turn them into short story-driven videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Those videos are also my portfolio for hotel and tourism-board clients, so the standard is high and the look is consistent.



I'm looking for a detail-obsessed short-form video editor to cut 3–5 vertical videos a week, plus some longer YouTube episodes later.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit 60–90 second vertical videos (9:16, 1080x1920) from my iPhone footage and recorded voiceover

- Build the edit around the story: strong hook in the first 2 seconds, fast pacing, cuts timed to the voiceover, high audience retention

- Select the best B-roll from long raw clips (you will watch every clip all the way through – the best moments are often in the middle)

- Clean up voiceover audio: remove false starts and breaths while keeping natural pauses, add room tone, mix to -14 LUFS

- Add minimal, elegant word-by-word captions (I'll give you the exact style)

- Colour grade with my LUTs (.cube files) for a cool, matte, under-saturated look

- Add subtle background music (no beat, low volume) and light sound design

- Export clean masters plus a caption-free version for hotel clients

- Organise files and follow my naming system in Google Drive



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years editing short-form social media video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

- Portfolio with at least 3 vertical videos you edited – links required

- Strong storytelling sense: hooks, pacing, retention editing, A-roll/B-roll structure, J-cuts and L-cuts, cutting on motion

- Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or CapCut Pro

- Colour grading with LUTs, including converting iPhone HDR (HLG/Dolby Vision) footage to Rec.709 before applying a LUT

- Audio editing and loudness normalisation

- Clear written English and reliable communication

- Fast internet for downloading 4K footage



NICE TO HAVE

- Travel, hospitality, luxury or documentary-style editing experience

- Long-form YouTube editing

- Thumbnail design

- Understanding of Instagram and TikTok analytics (watch time, average view duration, saves)



MY STYLE (please read)

Restrained and cinematic. Think documentary, not hype. No zoom transitions, no emoji, no bouncing text, no yellow captions, no stock footage. Straight cuts timed to the words. Every shot has to come from the place the story is about. If you love subtle, tasteful editing, this job is for you.



THE JOB

- Part-time, about 20 hours a week, flexible hours

- $7–8 USD per hour, depending on experience and your test edit

- Long-term role with raises for consistent quality

- Paid trial first: I'll send you footage and a voiceover for one 60–90 second video and pay $25 for the test edit



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Newport hook" so I know you read the whole post

2. Send links to 3 short-form videos you edited, and tell me what you did on each one

3. Tell me which editing software you use and your typical turnaround for a 60-second video

4. In one or two sentences, tell me how you would open a video about a historic hotel so viewers don't scroll away



Applications without portfolio links will not be reviewed.

description:
Job Title: Physician Licensing & Onboarding Specialist



Department: Credentialing



Reports To: VP of Revenue Cycle

Job Overview



We are seeking an organized, process-driven Physician Licensing & Onboarding Specialist to lead state medical licensing, license maintenance, and onboarding for our Rounding and Collaborating Physicians. In this role, your primary mission is to manage end-to-end state medical board applications, expedite multi-state licensing, and track active license renewals across target states. You will serve as the core liaison for our medical staff, ensuring full regulatory compliance, active state licensure, and seamless credentialing for rapid deployment into partner Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs). Qualifications & Requirements:

title: Content & Video Operator | AI-Native Founder Brand
description:
Elite Careers Strategy (ECS) is a London-based private advisory helping ambitious candidates and families pursue highly selective careers in corporate law, investment banking, private equity and related fields.



We are building an AI-native content and distribution engine around our founder’s expertise, our client outcomes and our research into how selective institutions choose talent.



We are looking for a Content & Video Operator to own the execution layer of that engine.



This is not simply a video editing role.



It is not a traditional social media manager role either.



We want someone who can take raw founder recordings, calls, ideas and AI-generated content briefs and reliably turn them into excellent finished content across YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram and other platforms.



The right person combines video editing ability, content judgement, strong taste, operational discipline and comfort working with AI.



What you will own



You will take content from raw material through to finished, publishable assets.



This will include:



* Editing founder-led long-form YouTube videos

* Turning longer recordings into high-quality short-form clips

* Identifying the strongest moments yourself rather than waiting for timestamps

* Cutting repetition, pauses and weak sections

* Improving pacing and retention while preserving the speaker’s meaning

* Creating clean captions, graphics, screenshots and B-roll where useful

* Preparing thumbnails and other supporting creative assets

* Repurposing one strong piece of source material across multiple platforms

* Formatting content correctly for YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels

* Managing the content calendar and production pipeline

* Maintaining an organised library of raw footage, projects and finished assets

* Uploading and publishing approved content

* Tracking what has been produced, approved and published

* Spotting bottlenecks and fixing them before the founder needs to intervene

* Using AI and automation wherever they can improve speed, consistency or quality



The objective is simple:



The founder should create once. The system should turn that into many high-quality pieces of content without requiring the founder to manage the production process.



How we work



ECS is an AI-native company.



You will not be expected to sit alone thinking of every content idea from scratch.



Our AI systems can support research, topic identification, scripts, hooks, titles, written repurposing, content briefs, transcripts and quality control.



Your job is to be excellent at the parts where a capable human operator still creates substantial value:



taste, audiovisual craft, editorial judgement, execution and operational ownership.



You should naturally ask:



“How can AI or automation remove unnecessary manual work from this process?”



We do not want someone who uses AI to produce mediocre content faster.



We want someone who combines AI leverage with high standards.



Our content style



Our audience includes ambitious students and young professionals, but also parents, senior professionals, private bankers and other sophisticated audiences.



The ECS brand should feel:



Intelligent. Premium. Understated. Credible. Modern.



We do not want generic influencer editing.



That means avoiding:



* Constant unnecessary zooms

* Excessive animations

* Meme-style editing

* Random sound effects

* Cheap-looking templates

* Sensationalist clickbait

* Visual clutter

* Editing that competes with the underlying idea



Strong editing should make an intelligent person easier and more compelling to listen to.



The viewer should notice the quality of the content before they notice the editing.



What we are looking for



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Are already a very capable video editor

* Understand storytelling, pacing and viewer retention

* Can identify strong clips without being given timestamps

* Have good visual taste

* Understand premium business, educational or founder-led content

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Have strong written English

* Are highly organised

* Can manage multiple pieces of content through a production pipeline

* Take ownership rather than waiting for instructions

* Can receive direct feedback without becoming defensive

* Learn brand preferences quickly

* Are comfortable working independently

* Already use AI extensively or are excited to become extremely good at it



Experience editing founder, business, educational, podcast or professional-services content would be particularly useful.



What this role is NOT



We are not looking for someone who needs instructions such as:



“Cut 1:32 to 2:17.”



“Add captions here.”



“Please upload this tomorrow.”



“Can you remind me which videos haven’t been published?”



The operator should increasingly own those decisions.



We also do not need a traditional content strategist producing generic lists of social-media ideas. Much of our research, strategy and written-content generation can already be handled using AI.



We need someone who can turn intelligence into finished output and make sure the output actually ships.



What success looks like



A successful workflow might look like this:



Founder records 30 minutes of high-quality material.



Our AI system analyses it, identifies the strongest ideas and helps create the content direction.



You then:



* Produce the polished long-form video

* Identify and edit the strongest short-form clips

* Create the necessary visual assets

* Prepare platform-specific versions

* Coordinate the written assets produced alongside it

* Organise everything correctly

* Publish approved content

* Track the output

* Feed performance information back into the content system



The founder does not spend time choosing timestamps, resizing clips, chasing edits, organising folders, checking whether something was uploaded or explaining the same editing preference repeatedly.



That is what ownership means in this role.



Application process



Please do not send us a huge generic portfolio.



Instead, send us your three strongest examples of work most relevant to this role.



For each example, briefly explain:



1. What you personally did



Be precise about what was your work versus somebody else’s.



2. Why you made the editing decisions you made



We care about judgement, not simply software ability.



Then answer these four questions:



1. You receive a 30-minute recording from the founder discussing a topic within his expertise. How would you turn it into one strong YouTube video, several short-form clips and supporting content?



2. Which parts of that workflow would you use AI for, and which would you deliberately keep human?



3. What video editing, design, AI and publishing tools do you currently use?



4. Give us one example where you improved a content workflow rather than simply completing the task you were given.



Please start your application with:



ECS CONTENT



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Paid practical test



The strongest applicants will complete a paid practical test.



Candidates will receive the same ECS source material and brief.



We will assess:



* Editorial judgement

* Video quality

* Ability to identify the strongest content

* Pacing and retention

* Brand fit

* Attention to detail

* Appropriate use of AI

* Ability to follow a brief

* Turnaround time

* Overall judgement



We care much more about the quality of your actual work than an impressive CV.



Role structure



We expect to begin with a paid practical test and trial period, followed by an ongoing role for the right person.



Compensation will depend on experience, capability and the level of responsibility you can genuinely own.



There is meaningful room for the role to grow. Someone exceptional could ultimately take substantial ownership of ECS’s content production and distribution operation.



If you are an excellent editor who also thinks like an operator, we would like to hear from you.

title: Crypto BD Lead (Player-Coach)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

title: Attorneys, Paralegals & Law Graduates: Long-Term Remote Article Writer (Detailed Briefs Provided)
description:
Full-time preferred (multiple part-time writers also considered).



If you have a legal background — practicing attorney, former attorney, paralegal, law graduate, or legal researcher — and you're looking for steady remote writing income, this project fits the way you already work.



We're hiring a dedicated writer for a long-term, high-volume semantic SEO content project. This is steady, ongoing work with no planned end date — our current writers have been with us for five years, and strong writers will have as much work as they can handle, every week.



Why legal professionals do well here



Legal work trains you to follow a strict format, use precise language, define terms carefully, and never stray from the instruction you were given. That's exactly what this job rewards. Each article comes with a brief (the required structure) and a style guide (the required language). Think of it as drafting to a template: your job is to fill the structure accurately and clearly, not to editorialize. Writers who read every instruction the way they'd read a court rule do very well.



What the work looks like



You'll receive a complete brief (outline) and a set of writing rules for every article. Your job is to research the topic and write to the brief — nothing else. No pitching topics, no guessing what we want. The brief tells you the structure and the subtopics to cover; the guidelines tell you the style: tone, sentence structure, vocabulary, expressions to use, and words to avoid.



Research is light to moderate — enough to write accurately about each point in the brief, not deep original investigation.



This job rewards precision, not creativity. If you enjoy following a clear system and getting it exactly right, you'll do very well here. If you prefer creative freedom, this isn't your project.



Important — this is 100% manual writing



AI-generated or AI-assisted drafts are not accepted. All articles are written in shared Google Docs with version history, and drafts are checked with AI-detection tools. If a draft flags, we review the edit history with you before making a call — but confirmed AI use ends the contract. If you write everything yourself, this will never be an issue for you.



Pay



$0.01–$0.03 per word depending on experience and aptitude, paid per completed article that passes our guidelines. At $0.02/word, a 5,000-word article = $100. Rates are reviewed as you demonstrate consistency with the system.



Because volume is unlimited, your monthly income is set by your own output. Writers who master our system can produce quickly and consistently — the guidelines feel dense on your first article and become second nature by your third.



Turnaround



Fast delivery matters. Once you're up to speed, the expectation is same-day or next-day turnaround per article.



How to apply



1. Start your application with the word "cornerstone" — applications without it will not be read.

2. Include 1–2 writing samples (informational articles preferred, not sales copy).

3. Tell us in one sentence how you make sure an article follows a detailed style guide.

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:
We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Engineer (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.



Are you an ambitious IT professional who loves solving hands-on technical challenges, learning modern cloud and infrastructure stacks, and helping businesses make smart technology decisions? If you have solid IT fundamentals, a strong work ethic, clear communication skills, and a desire to grow into an elite Technical Account Engineer, we want to invest in you.



We believe curiosity, logical problem-solving, and trainability matter far more than checking every single technical box. We provide dedicated mentorship, hands-on project exposure, and company-sponsored certifications to help you master advanced cloud architectures, security frameworks, and client technical guidance.



What You Will Do

* Technical Guidance & Infrastructure Reviews: Collaborate with client stakeholders and US account teams to review IT environment health, identify potential technical risks, and help plan proactive upgrades.

* Hands-on Implementation & Modernization: Assist with and execute core infrastructure upgrades, including Microsoft 365 migrations, Azure/Microsoft Entra ID configurations, network switch and firewall setups, backup validation, and endpoint security deployments.

* Technical Scoping & Project Planning: Work alongside Project Specialists and Account Managers to assess client infrastructure, evaluate technical dependencies, estimate engineering effort, and draft clear project scopes.

* Standardization & Documentation: Ensure smooth operational handoffs to the service delivery team by building structured network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures in a documentation platform.

* Continuous Technical Growth: Expand your engineering toolkit through hands-on project execution, cross-training with senior specialists, and structured certification roadmaps.



What We Are Looking For



* Smart & Fast Learner: Strong grasp of core IT fundamentals (Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, and basic networking concepts) and a natural curiosity to explore how things work.

* Trainable & Solutions-Oriented: You do not need to know every technology on day one. We value the drive to research solutions, learn from senior engineers, embrace feedback, and quickly master new systems.

* Clear, Professional Communication: Ability to explain technical setups and project updates clearly and professionally in English, both in written documentation and in conversations with business clients.

* Hands-on Technical Background: 1 to 3+ years in IT support or systems administration (L2 support, junior systems engineer, or technical support specialist), preferably with some exposure to multi-client or MSP environments.

* Ownership & Reliability: Dependable, organized, and focused on delivering clean project cutovers with minimal downtime.

* Schedule & Setup: Comfortable working US business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines) from a dedicated home office with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.



Nice to Have:



* Prior experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment or using RMM/PSA tools.

* Hands-on exposure to firewall configurations (Ubiquiti, Cisco, Fortinet), VLANs, VPNs, or tenant-to-tenant migrations.

* Foundational industry certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals / Azure Administrator, or CCNA).

* Familiarity with centralized documentation platforms.



Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Combine client-facing technical advisory with hands-on infrastructure engineering projects.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

* Clear career development pathways toward Senior Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, or Engineering Leadership.



What Sets Us Apart?



* We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally:

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input, respects your expertise, and supports your success.

* Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of working remotely from home while delivering high-value, impactful projects.



How to Apply



If you are a consultative, technically strong IT professional who enjoys leading strategic client conversations and executing modern infrastructure projects, apply now!

1. Subject Line Requirement: Submit your application and include the numbers (2029) in your
 subject line. This helps us ensure you have read the complete job post.

We're hiring a dedicated writer for a long-term, high-volume semantic SEO content project. This is steady, ongoing work with no planned end date — our current writers have been with us for five years, and strong writers will have as much work as they can handle, every week.



Why teachers do well here



You've spent years grading against rubrics and writing lesson plans to standards. Our system is a rubric: each article has a brief that defines the structure and a style guide that defines the language. Writers who treat the guidelines the way they'd treat a grading rubric — every criterion checked, nothing skipped — produce articles that pass on the first submission. Clear, plain, instructive writing is the goal; no flair required.



What the work looks like



You'll receive a complete brief (outline) and a set of writing rules for every article. Your job is to research the topic and write to the brief — nothing else. No pitching topics, no guessing what we want. The brief tells you the structure and the subtopics to cover; the guidelines tell you the style: tone, sentence structure, vocabulary, expressions to use, and words to avoid.



Research is light to moderate — enough to write accurately about each point in the brief, not deep original investigation.



This job rewards precision, not creativity. If you enjoy following a clear system and getting it exactly right, you'll do very well here. If you prefer creative freedom, this isn't your project.



Important — this is 100% manual writing



AI-generated or AI-assisted drafts are not accepted. All articles are written in shared Google Docs with version history, and drafts are checked with AI-detection tools. If a draft flags, we review the edit history with you before making a call — but confirmed AI use ends the contract. If you write everything yourself, this will never be an issue for you.



Pay



$0.01–$0.03 per word depending on experience and aptitude, paid per completed article that passes our guidelines. At $0.02/word, a 5,000-word article = $100. Rates are reviewed as you demonstrate consistency with the system.



Because volume is unlimited, your monthly income is set by your own output. Writers who master our system can produce quickly and consistently — the guidelines feel dense on your first article and become second nature by your third.



Turnaround



Fast delivery matters. Once you're up to speed, the expectation is same-day or next-day turnaround per article.



How to apply



1. Start your application with the word "cornerstone" — applications without it will not be read.





What happens next



Respond to this ad and we'll send you a short personality test. If it's a fit, you'll receive a test article with a full brief and our writing guidelines, so you'll see exactly how the system works. If you're hired, the test article is paid at the base rate of $0.01 per word.

-term contract

ABOUT LN & CO.

LN & Co. is a multicultural digital marketing agency built on a simple idea: culture comes first, and technology carries it. Founded by Layla E. Nielsen, we help brands connect with women and multicultural audiences through social media strategy, content, and community that honor who those audiences really are. Our clients span faith-based organizations, nonprofits, beauty brands, and technology companies, and our small global team produces work that looks and feels like it belongs to each one of them.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a Content Producer to own the creative output behind our clients’ social media. You will turn monthly content calendars into finished video and graphics that are ready to publish, and you will be the person who takes a client’s design brief or a round of feedback and shapes it into work that lands the first time.



The heart of this role is translation. A client sends notes, a brief, or reference material, and you turn it into scroll-stopping Reels, short-form video, and branded graphics that hold up on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and everywhere else they live. You will report to Joanne Gonzalez, our Design Lead, and partner closely with account managers and coordinators across several client accounts at once. If you love the craft of taking rough direction and raw footage and making something polished and on-brand out of it, this is your seat.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Produce short-form video and Reels for client accounts, editing client-provided footage into finished pieces up to around 60 seconds, complete with captions, on-screen text, and platform-ready formatting.



Design custom graphics and multi-slide carousels that follow each client’s brand standards and our own visual system.



Read client design briefs and revision notes closely and turn them into finished assets with minimal back and forth.



Work from monthly content calendars on a rolling production schedule, hitting publish dates and moving cleanly through revision rounds.



Keep every piece consistent with the client’s brand and with our Culture + Technology approach, which centers women and multicultural audiences in the work rather than treating them as an afterthought.



Manage your production queue in Notion, coordinate with account managers and coordinators, and flag anything that needs a client decision early.



Adapt each piece to the platform it lives on, from a vertical Reel to a LinkedIn carousel, with the pacing and format each one rewards.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Five or more years producing social media content, ideally in an agency or fast-moving brand setting, with a portfolio or reel we can watch.



Strong short-form video editing skills and comfort in tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or their equivalents, plus a good ear for pacing, captions, and sound.



Graphic design ability across static posts and carousels, fluent in the Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or both, with a clean, editorial eye.



A real track record of taking client feedback and briefs and delivering exactly what was asked, without needing three rounds to get there.



Command of how content performs across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads,
, and YouTube, and a feel for how each one is different.



Cultural fluency and genuine care for producing work that represents women and multicultural audiences with depth, not decoration.



The organization to juggle several clients and deadlines at once, and the judgment to protect quality while you do it.



Must be available Eastern Standard Time from 9am - 5pm (Required)



NICE TO HAVE

Light copywriting for captions and on-screen text.



Experience with Sprout Social, Metricool, or similar scheduling and reporting tools.



Motion graphics or basic animation.

Send your resume and portfolio or showreel along with a short note about one piece you produced from someone else’s brief, and what you did to make it stronger, and email it to

title: Senior Creative Director / Web & UI/UX Designer (Figma & Graphic Design)
description:
Are you an experienced Senior Web Designer & Creative Director who takes full ownership of design direction from brief to final delivery?



JRoc Digital is looking for an elite Creative Director to lead our web and graphic design department. We build high-end custom websites and visual branding for our clients, and we need someone who takes real visual leadership—delivering client-ready concepts without needing micro-management or constant design revisions.



If you are a Figma master who understands conversion principles, clean modern aesthetics, brand identity, and multi-page site architecture, we want to work with you.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Lead Web & UI/UX Design (Figma): Turn detailed briefs into modern, high-converting custom website layouts (desktop & mobile) across core pages, sub-pages, components, and modals.



Creative Direction: Own the visual strategy. You take responsibility for layout logic, typography, visual hierarchy, and UI polish—delivering client-ready work from day one.



Graphic Design & Branding: Produce supporting visual assets as needed (brand identity kits, logos, social graphics, ad creatives, pitch decks, and digital assets).



Developer Handoff: Structure Figma files cleanly with auto-layouts, components, and global styles so our dev team (building in WordPress) can execute seamlessly.



Who You Are:

Self-Directed Leader: You know what world-class design looks like and take complete ownership from brief to final sign-off.



Figma Master: Expert in auto-layouts, components, global styles, responsive views, and UI modals.



Conversion-Minded: You design for user experience and conversions, not just aesthetics.



WordPress Aware: You understand how web designs translate into code/builders (experience or familiarity with WordPress / Bricks Builder is a major bonus).



Reliable & Fast: You respect build timelines and hit deliverable targets consistently.



Project Scope & Terms:

Structure: Per-project basis to start, with potential to move to a long-term monthly retainer as client volume increases.



Core Web Build Rate: $700 AUD flat per full custom web design project (covering core pages, inner layouts, and components).



Turnaround Expectations:



3 Days: Initial Homepage design concepts.



5 Days: Remaining inner pages complete post-homepage approval.



Additional standalone graphic design work or custom branding collateral billed at an agreed per-asset or project rate.



How to Apply (IMPORTANT):

We don't want a massive link dump of 50 average designs. We want to see your absolute elite work.



To apply, send a message fulfilling these exact 3 requirements:



1. Your TOP 3 Web Design Projects: For each project, provide:

    • The live website link

    • The original Figma file link (view access)



2. Branding & Visual Kits: Include 1–2 examples of full brand identity/visual style guides you have built (logos, typography, color palettes, brand collateral).



3. Subject Line Requirement: Set your message subject line to "JRoc Creative Director - [Insert Your Favorite Website URL Here]".



(Note: Applications missing live site links, Figma access, or the correct subject line will be automatically archived without review).

- Manage the binding process from quote acceptance through policy issuance

- Follow up with underwriters on outstanding subjectivities and missing information

- Input and maintain accurate data in AMS360 (policy details, endorsements, certificates)

- Issue certificates of insurance (COIs) as needed

- Communicate professionally with carriers, underwriters, and internally with the team

- Track renewal timelines and flag upcoming deadlines



**Requirements**

- Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience in U.S. commercial lines insurance (agency or carrier side)

- Strong working knowledge of AMS360 — must be comfortable navigating it independently

- Advanced knowledge of commercial lines coverage: GL, property, workers' comp, umbrella/excess, and ACORD forms

- Excellent written and spoken English — you will be communicating directly with U.S. carriers and clients

- Familiarity with the quoting-to-binding workflow at a U.S. retail agency

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple accounts/deadlines at once

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet home office setup



**Nice to Have**

- Experience with multi-state accounts (NY, CT, MA a plus)

- Experience with carrier portals (e.g., Travelers, Utica, The Hartford, etc.)

- Prior experience working directly for a U.S. agency (not just BPO/call center)



**What We Offer**

title: Full-Time Junior Creative Strategist for Fast-Growing DTC Supplement Brand
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the health supplement space, scaling with performance-driven creatives. Every ad we launch is backed by data and crafted to convert. We're looking for a junior creative strategist who thinks in angles, writes with intent, and wants to master the craft of building ads that sell — someone who's hungry to learn, test relentlessly, and grow into a key player on our creative team.



The Role



We're hiring a Junior Creative Strategist who can develop compelling ad concepts with a focus on long-form statics and direct response copywriting for Meta & Google. This is a long-term, remote role with a starting salary of $7/hour, which increases if the hit rate is on target. Performance bonuses will also be introduced in the 2nd month.



What You'll Do



- Develop ad concepts and angles for long-form static ads (advertorials, listicles, comparison statics, and educational formats)

- Write direct response copy — headlines, hooks, body copy, and CTAs that drive action

- Research competitors, audiences, and market trends to find winning angles

- Build creative briefs for designers and video editors to execute on

- Work with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield) to speed up ideation and asset creation

- Analyze performance data and iterate on concepts based on KPIs (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS)

- Test different angles, formats, and messaging frameworks at volume

- Collaborate closely with the Creative Manager, editors, and designers to push output

- Study winning ads across the DTC space and break down what makes them convert

- Experiment with new formats, storytelling structures, and persuasion techniques



You Need



- Some experience with long-form static ads and/or direct response copywriting (even personal projects or spec work counts)

- A basic understanding of marketing psychology, hooks, and consumer behavior

- Strong writing skills — you know how to make people stop scrolling and start reading

- Willingness to produce volume — aim is 30+ static concepts per week

- Hunger to learn — you don't need to know everything, but you need to want to

- Ability to take feedback, move fast, and not get attached to ideas that don't perform

- Bonus: familiarity with the health/supplement space



A proven track record is a massive plus. If you've already worked on ads that performed — even a handful — that puts you ahead of the pack. We'd much rather see 3 real ads with real results than a polished portfolio with no data behind it.



What You'll Get



- Base salary: $7 per hour (starting salary that increases fast if performance is on target) + performance bonuses

- Fully remote role

- Direct mentorship and collaboration with experienced strategists, editors, and the Founder

- Managed under a dedicated Creative Manager who oversees strategy and creative output

- A real opportunity to grow into a senior strategist role as we scale



How to Apply



Start your application with the word ANGLE so we know you read the full post.



Then send us the following:



1. Your creative work



Send 3–5 examples of ad creatives you personally concepted, wrote copy for, or strategized — ideally static ads or written content that was used in paid campaigns.



For each example, include:



- A link or screenshot of the final creative

- What product/brand it was for

- What parts you were responsible for (concept, copy, design direction, full execution)

- Whether it ran as a paid ad, and on which platform



Portfolio pieces, freelance work, and spec projects are all acceptable — but real ads with real performance data will always stand out more.



2. Performance evidence (strongly preferred)



If any of your work ran as paid traffic, send screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or other platforms showing actual performance. This is where you can really separate yourself from other applicants.



Where available, we'd like to see metrics such as:



- Spend

- CTR

- CPC

- CPA / Cost per Purchase

- ROAS

- Hook rate / thumb-stop rate



We understand that juniors may not always have access to performance data. If you don't, that's okay — just be honest about it and tell us what you do know about how the creative performed. But if you do have data, share it. Proven results carry serious weight in this process.



You may blur client names, account IDs, revenue figures, or other sensitive information. We mainly want to verify that you have experience producing creatives that were genuinely used and tested with paid traffic.



3. Break down a winning ad



Pick any static ad or advertorial you've seen online that you think works well. In 200–300 words, break down:



- What angle it uses and why it's effective

- How the copy is structured

- What makes someone stop and read it

- What you'd test or change to improve it



This tells us more about your strategic thinking than any resume will.



4. Tell us which tools you use or want to learn



List the tools you currently use or are familiar with for:



- Copywriting and research

- Static ad design (Figma, Canva, Photoshop, etc.)

- AI content generation (ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield, etc.)

- Ad spying and competitor research

- Organizing and managing creative output



We're particularly interested in strategists who are comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, ideation, and first drafts.

Design reference

Please review this Figma before applying so you understand the look and feel we are going for: 
 Designs?node id=0 1&p=f

Someone with strong hands on experience building and customizing Shopify stores, who takes real ownership of the project and works independently once the brief is clear. Configure checkout, shipping settings and payment methods (iDEAL, Klarna, credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Amex)

Set up and connect apps: 
 for reviews, Klaviyo for
 marketing plus a newsletter signup discount

Build out remaining pages (About, FAQ, Shipping and Returns) with proper formatting and mobile responsiveness

Test the full store end to end on desktop and mobile before launch, including the checkout flow

Fixed price, one time project. The fixed price includes unlimited revisions until we are both happy with the result, so please price accordingly. Possible ongoing work afterward if it goes well.

Start your subject line with VAJA, then include, one, your relevant experience with Shopify builds, two, one or two examples of stores you have built or improved, three, your fixed price quote for the full scope above and your plan to hit the October 1 deadline.

title: Master Data Entry & Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly efficient Master Data Entry & Bookkeeping Specialist who can organize, clean, reconcile, and maintain structured business data while supporting bookkeeping and system setup.

Gotya is a digital pack-ripping platform for Pokémon card collectors, live at 
. Collectors open real packs online, hit real cards and get the physical card shipped to their door or bank the value straight back into their balance. Every pull is real and every card exists. We are a small remote team of collectors and builders, and we are growing fast.

Creators are the heart of this hobby. Collectors watch rip videos on YouTube, TikTok, Twitch and Instagram every day, and that is where our audience lives. - Track results per creator and report what works and what does not.

You have



- Hands-on influencer marketing experience, working directly with creators.

- Experience running campaigns on more than one platform.

- A clear process for finding, contacting, closing and managing creators.

- A track record you can talk about: campaigns you ran and what they delivered.

- Excellent written English, full-time availability, and overlap with US and European hours.

- Bonus if you know the trading card or collectibles community, or if you have worked with affiliate or rev-share deals.

- Fully remote, flexible hours with the overlap above.

- A competitive monthly rate plus a performance bonus.

- Direct line to the founder and real ownership of this channel.

- Room to grow as the channel grows.



How to apply

Qualified creator → personalized idea → conversation → approved partnership

research their profile

identify the best personal Momento angle

create simple card/mockup concepts using Canva, AI, or similar tools

write personalized outreach

send DMs/emails

follow up

manage conversations

move interested creators toward an approved collaboration

keep the pipeline organized

hand approved partnerships to our production team

Creator → personalized concept → outreach → follow-up → partnership

Take a quick look at Momento first:



Website:

MOMENTO

whether you understand low-pressure, personalized outreach

.

title: SEO Specialist/Strategist
description:
SEO Specialist: Full Time (40 hrs/week), Remote (Evening/Night Shift, Philippines)



Hi, and thanks for taking a look. I'm a freelance SEO consultant hiring one person to grow with long term. Please read the full post before applying, especially the hours and how to apply.





IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?



- You have at least 2 years of hands-on SEO experience. More experience is preferred. This isn't an entry-level role, but you don't need to be an expert. Juniors and experienced candidates are both welcome, and pay reflects experience.

- You can commit to a full-time shift approximately 4pm - 12pm in the Philippines.

- You want a long-term role where you do the SEO work yourself. There is huge room for growth in your knowledge, experience, and skillset, delivering SEO to world class standards.





THE ROLE



- There's more client work than I can handle alone, and you'll own SEO strategy and execution across several accounts.

- The role is behind the scenes. You won't have client contact, and your work goes out under my name.

- You'll brief and QA writers, off-page specialists and designers.

- Once we agree on a plan, you run with it and come to me when something needs a decision.

- Responsibility and pay grow as trust builds.





WORKING TOGETHER



- I value kindness, respect and honest two-way communication, and will always treat people I work with the same way. This includes raising issues and giving me critical feedback. Standards are high, but realistic and respectful of your life outside work.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include all three of these in your first message. I read every application myself, and I can only consider applications that include everything.



1. CV: a Google Drive link set to "anyone with the link can view"



2. A ~5 minute video (Loom or similar), also as a Google Drive link. A general video you've already recorded is fine. Please talk naturally rather than reading from a script. Cover:

- Your SEO background, in detail

- Projects you're proud of and exactly what you did on them

- Ideally, how your experience fits a role like this, and any skill gaps you'd like to fill



3. Your available date(s) and start time for the paid test task (please state UK time)







HIRING PROCESS



1. Apply (see above)

2. Paid test task: 4 hours, $20, paid to everyone who submits. I'll send it at the time you've chosen.

   - You can use AI as you would in the role, but you'll need to talk to me through your work and reasoning at the interview.

3. Final interview

4. Offer: requires two contactable references and a signed NDA





TERMS



- Pay: $700–$1,200/month, depending on experience.

  - Juniors (1-2 years) start toward the lower end of the band. Experienced candidates start higher.

  - Pay is reviewed on performance. High-quality, proactive, independent work moves you toward the top of the band, with further growth as clients grow.

- Hours: 40 hrs/week, Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm UK time. Hours can shift later but not earlier.

  - Late March to late October: 4pm–12am Manila

  - Late October to late March: 5pm–1am Manila

- This is a night shift in the Philippines. Please only apply if these hours work for you long term.

- Workload: This is a full-time role. The workload will build up as new accounts are onboarded, and we'll discuss the details at the interview.

- Time off: 10–20 paid days off per year, agreed in advance.

- Tools and training: all provided, including Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Monday/Asana and AI subscriptions, plus training (such as Udemy) and existing SOPs.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Research and strategy: keyword research and clustering, intent mapping, competitor, SERP and content gap analysis, and account roadmaps

- On-page and content: writer-ready briefs, editing and QA, titles, metas and headings, content calendars, and refreshing decayed pages

- Internal linking: linking maps, orphaned pages, anchor planning, and implementation

- Technical: Screaming Frog audits, indexation, site structure, redirects, schema, and prioritised fix lists

- Off-page: backlink and competitor gap analysis, prospecting, briefing link specialists, and Reddit seeding

- Conversion: landing and sales page audits

- Reporting: monthly reports and decks from GA4, Search Console and Ahrefs (Looker Studio a plus)

- Local: Google Business Profile optimisation and posting

- AI search: visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews

- Project management: planning across accounts, chasing delivery, and QAing everything before it reaches clients





MUST-HAVES



- 1-2+ years of hands-on SEO. You do the work yourself; this is not an oversight role.

- Excellent written and spoken English, and clear communication

- Ahrefs, Search Console and GA4, used to find cause and effect, not just to export reports

- Sheets or Excel and Slides

- Screaming Frog, WordPress or a similar CMS, and Monday or a similar PM tool

- Daily use of Claude or ChatGPT

- Well organised, proactive, and raises problems early

- Reliable, fast internet and a machine that can handle screen-sharing

- Two screens, for working on two screens at the same time. Ideally a second machine (laptop/pc etc.) as well but not essential



Hands-on experience matters more than years on a CV. Agency experience is a strong plus. If you meet most of these but not all, still apply and mention your gaps in your video.





HOW YOU WORK



- You check numbers before using them and can explain what drove a change.

- You flag problems instead of quietly working around them.

- You're careful with client data and access.

- You build systems: SOPs, templates, reusable AI prompts and small automations. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should want to become one.

- You use AI to work faster, not to replace your thinking. You can explain and defend everything you send.





Thanks for reading. I look forward to hearing from you.



Quick reminder: please include your CV link, video link, and test task date and time in your first message.
