title: Full-Stack Developer – Custom CRM & Business Systems
description:
Full-Stack Developer – Custom CRM & Business Systems



We are a Melbourne-based building products company with our own custom internal business-management system. The system includes CRM, quotations, orders, purchasing and compliance.



Our existing system has been built by our systems lead using AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code. We are looking for a developer who can work closely with him to maintain, complete and expand the system.



This is a long-term position supporting an existing system—not a one-time project or a complete rebuild.



Your responsibilities



* Learn and understand our existing system and code structure

* Complete the remaining CRM modules and improve existing features

* Build call-management and customer-outreach workflows

* Develop new features as the business grows

* Create and update database tables, views, functions and security policies

* Build user-facing screens using plain JavaScript

* Write and perform tests before changes are released

* Create a separate Git branch for each task and submit the work through a pull request

* Work with our systems lead to review and deploy approved changes

* Investigate and fix bugs when problems occur

* Clearly document the features you build and the changes you make

* Protect company and customer data by following proper security and access procedures



 How we develop



We use AI tools to help write much of the code. You must be confident directing AI tools, reviewing the code they produce, testing it properly and correcting any mistakes.



AI-assisted development is encouraged, but you must understand and take responsibility for every piece of code you submit. Copying and pasting AI-generated code without checking or understanding it is not acceptable.



We are looking for someone who can use AI to work efficiently while still producing reliable, secure and maintainable code.



Technical requirements



The most important requirement is strong PostgreSQL experience, including:



* Tables and relationships

* Views

* Functions

* Database migrations

* Row-Level Security policies

* Data integrity and security



You will also need:



* Strong JavaScript experience

* Experience working with plain or vanilla JavaScript without a front-end framework

* Git and GitHub experience

* A clear understanding of branches, commits and pull requests

* Experience with Supabase, or the ability to learn it quickly

* Experience maintaining and expanding an existing production system

* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

* Clear written English, as most daily communication will be in writing

* The ability to provide regular updates and meet agreed deadlines

* At least four working hours each day that overlap with Melbourne business hours



At least three years of relevant commercial development experience is preferred.



Experience in the construction or building-products industry is not required. We will teach you how our business operates.



Upcoming development



The first priority is to complete the remaining CRM modules and improve unfinished areas.



Future stages will include:



1. Warehouse management, including inventory, stock locations, receiving and order picking

2. Shipping and container tracking

3. Dashboards and business reporting

4. Accounting integrations

5. Connections with other business tools and services



This is an ongoing system that will continue to grow as the company expands.



To apply, please send us:



* Your CV

* Your GitHub profile or portfolio

* Examples of CRMs, internal systems or business platforms you have worked on

* A clear explanation of which parts you personally developed

* Your experience with PostgreSQL, JavaScript and Supabase

* Your availability and preferred working hours

* Your expected hourly or monthly rate

title: Sales Outreach & Appointment Setting VA
description:
# Sales Outreach & Appointment Setting VA



We are looking for a proactive, highly organized **full-time Sales Outreach & Appointment Setting VA** to support a high-ticket closer in the online education space.



This is a **written outreach role only**. There is **no calling**. All communication with leads will be handled through **SMS,
, and other approved written channels**.



You will not be responsible for finding leads from scratch. Leads are already generated through **paid advertising, funnels, webinars, applications, setters, and other marketing channels**.



Some leads may already have spoken with the sales team, while others may be in the database but have never been contacted directly before.



Your role is to work within the existing lead database, start and continue conversations, follow up consistently, and help turn interested prospects into qualified, booked, and attended sales calls.



## What you'll be doing



* Reaching out to new and existing company-generated leads

* Following up with leads who have not yet booked a call

* Re-engaging older leads who previously showed interest

* Responding to replies from SMS and
 outreach

* Following up with webinar, funnel, and application leads

* Booking qualified prospects onto the closer's calendar

* Confirming upcoming appointments

* Following up with no-shows and helping them reschedule

* Managing scheduled callbacks and future follow-ups

* Keeping CRM notes, lead statuses, and follow-up dates organized

* Providing relevant lead notes to the closer before appointments

* Tracking conversations, bookings, reschedules, and attended calls



## Your main goal



Your goal is not simply to send as many messages as possible.



Your goal is to create more meaningful sales opportunities by moving leads through the following process:



**Lead identified → Conversation started → Interest established → Qualified prospect → Booked call → Attended call**



We are looking for someone who is persistent without being pushy and can communicate naturally rather than sounding robotic or overly salesy.



## What we're looking for



You may be a good fit if you:



* Have experience with appointment setting, sales outreach, lead follow-up, or sales support

* Have excellent written English

* Are comfortable communicating through SMS and

* Can write naturally and conversationally

* Are organized and comfortable working inside a CRM

* Can manage multiple leads and follow-ups without losing track

* Can follow scripts and SOPs while still using good judgment

* Are proactive and do not need constant reminders

* Keep accurate notes and follow-up dates

* Are dependable and consistent



Experience supporting a **high-ticket sales team, online education company, coaching business, or similar environment** is a plus.



## Hours



This is a **full-time role of approximately 35–40 hours per week, spread across 6 days**.



Some working hours will need to overlap with the closer's sales schedule so you can handle active replies, appointment confirmations, no-shows, and other time-sensitive follow-up.



The exact working schedule will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.



## How success will be measured



Performance will be based on outcomes such as:



* Interested conversations generated

* Qualified prospects identified

* Appointments booked

* No-shows recovered and rescheduled

* Appointment show rate

* Attended sales calls generated

* Follow-up consistency

* CRM accuracy and organization



We value thoughtful, consistent follow-up over simply sending a high volume of messages.



## How to apply



Please begin your application with the word **PIPELINE** so we know you read the full job description.



Please include

1. Your previous experience with appointment setting, sales outreach, or lead follow-up

2. What CRMs or sales tools you have used

3. How you would follow up with a lead who expressed interest but stopped responding

4. Your availability and timezone

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. Whether you are currently working for any other clients, and approximately how many hours per week

title: Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads
description:

Company: Delusion Depot

Website: 

Contact: 



We are preparing to launch Delusion Depot, a U.S.-based consumer-products e-commerce brand, and are looking for an experienced e-commerce professional to help take the business from its current pre-launch stage into active operations and growth.



This can be a part-time or full-time position depending on the candidate, experience and availability. We are looking for a long-term relationship, with the opportunity for the role and responsibilities to grow as the business grows.



This is not primarily a customer-service VA position and is not a simple data-entry role.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of projects, identifying what needs to be done, researching solutions, and moving work forward without requiring detailed instructions for every task.



Where We Are Now



A significant portion of our initial physical inventory has already been manufactured and received.



Our Shopify website is substantially built and the products are loaded, but the backend catalog, product data, metadata and SEO still need to be completed, audited and organized.



We have not yet launched on Amazon or TikTok Shop, and we need to select and onboard a U.S. 3PL/pick-and-pack fulfillment partner.



We are also preparing to begin our marketing and customer-acquisition programs.



Responsibilities



The person we hire will help with areas including:



Shopify product and catalog management



Product data, SKUs, variants, collections, metadata and inventory



Shopify SEO and ongoing site optimization



Amazon Seller Central setup and management



Amazon product listings, catalog structure, variations and marketplace SEO



TikTok Shop setup and operations



Researching and coordinating with U.S. 3PL/fulfillment providers



Inventory and fulfillment coordination



Google Search Console and Merchant Center



Keyword and competitor research



Developing and executing an ongoing SEO strategy



Identifying organic content and search opportunities



Creator/influencer research and outreach



Product-seeding campaigns



Creator and affiliate tracking



TikTok Shop affiliate/creator programs



Coordinating short-form content across TikTok, Instagram and



Using AI tools to assist with research, content development, social listening and workflow efficiency



Tracking performance across products, creators, content, SEO and sales channels



Building reports, SOPs and repeatable processes



Coordinating with outside specialists when work requires expertise beyond your own



Marketing & Growth



Delusion Depot is a brand where culture, humor, current conversations and highly shareable content will play an important role in customer acquisition.



We intend to build a creator/product-seeding program, develop affiliate relationships, create frequent short-form content, identify relevant trending conversations where the brand can participate organically, build organic search traffic, and use data to determine which products, content, creators and channels deserve additional investment.



We are interested in using AI extensively—not as a replacement for judgment or creativity, but as a tool for social listening, trend identification, research, content development, analysis and workflow automation.



We are therefore looking for someone interested in both e-commerce operations and growth, not simply maintaining product listings.



What We're Looking For



You do not need to be an expert in every responsibility listed above.



We would rather hire someone with strong experience in several core areas who can independently learn and manage additional responsibilities as the business grows.



Strong candidates will ideally have meaningful hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify



Amazon Seller Central



E-commerce catalog/product management



SEO and keyword research



Inventory and fulfillment



3PL or warehouse coordination



TikTok Shop



Creator/influencer outreach



Affiliate programs



Google Merchant Center and Search Console



Klaviyo or e-commerce
 marketing



Analytics and reporting



AI tools for research, content and workflow automation



The Person We're Looking For



The most important characteristic is ownership.



If given an objective, you should be comfortable determining the steps required, organizing the work, identifying problems, researching solutions and bringing decisions to us when needed.



We do not want someone who simply waits each day for a list of tasks.



At the same time, we don't expect you to pretend to know everything. Knowing when a specialized problem requires outside expertise is also important.



Hours



We are open to either part-time or full-time for the right person.



For a strong candidate, this may begin as a part-time role during the launch phase and grow into a larger or full-time position as Delusion Depot scales. We are also open to hiring someone full-time from the beginning if their experience and capabilities justify it.



To Apply



Please send your application to 
 and briefly describe:



Your experience with Shopify and Amazon Seller Central.



The e-commerce responsibilities you have personally owned rather than simply assisted with.

Long-term opportunity with the potential for increasing responsibility as Delusion Depot grows.

You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes :

title: Speaking Outreach & Administrative Assistant
description:
I am an author, speaker, and business coach looking for a highly organized Virtual Assistant to help build and manage my speaking outreach and booking system.



My primary goal is to book speaking engagements, workshops, and events with professional associations, business groups, corporations, entrepreneur organizations, wellness organizations, yoga studios, bookstores, community organizations, and other groups.



I already use AI tools to conduct much of the research. I am not looking for someone to spend hours randomly searching the internet.



I need someone who can take the opportunities we find and make sure they are organized, contacted, followed up with, and never forgotten.



Your Main Responsibility

You will own the administrative side of my speaking outreach system.

Your job is simple:

Keep the speaking pipeline organized and moving every week.



What You Will Do



You will:

Review speaking opportunities generated through AI research.

Organize and clean prospect information.

Remove duplicate organizations and contacts.

Research missing information when necessary.

Identify the correct person responsible for speakers, events, education, programming, or workshops.

Find and verify names, titles,
 addresses, websites, and phone numbers.

Maintain our master speaking prospect database.

Help determine which opportunities should receive priority.

Prepare personalized outreach using approved templates.

Send approved outreach
s.

Track every contact and response.

Make sure follow-ups happen on schedule.

Enter qualified opportunities into GoHighLevel.

Keep our GoHighLevel speaking pipeline current.

Schedule calls with interested organizations.

Immediately flag important opportunities that need my personal attention.

Keep speaking materials and documents organized in Google Drive.

Provide a short weekly report showing activity, responses, opportunities, and next actions.



Tools We Use



You should be comfortable with technology and preferably have experience with several of these:

Google Sheets

Google Drive

Gmail

GoHighLevel or another CRM

ChatGPT

Gemini

NotebookLM

AI research tools

You do not need to be an expert in every tool.

You do need to be comfortable learning new systems quickly.

Who I Am Looking For

I want someone who is:

Extremely organized.

Detail-oriented.

Reliable.

Comfortable working independently.

Strong in written English.

Good at internet research.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and CRM systems.

Experienced with lead generation, outreach, appointment setting, or sales administration.

Comfortable using AI tools.

Able to follow a system without needing constant supervision.

Willing to take responsibility for making sure follow-ups do not get missed.

I especially want someone who notices problems and fixes them instead of waiting for me to discover them.

This Is NOT a General VA Position

Initially, you will not be responsible for:

Social media management

Video editing

Graphic design

Website development

Book editing

Amazon advertising

 advertising

Your focus is:

Speaking Outreach + Organization + CRM + Follow-Up.

Hours and Compensation

The position starts at:

10 hours per week

Up to $7 USD per hour

The initial engagement will be a 30-day paid trial.

If we work well together and the system grows, there may be an opportunity for additional responsibilities and hours in the future.

How I Will Measure Success

I care about results, not simply hours worked.

Success means:

Our prospect database stays clean and current.

New opportunities are processed every week.

Decision makers are identified.

Contact information is accurate.

Outreach gets sent consistently.

Follow-ups happen on time.

Responses are recorded.

Qualified opportunities are moved into our CRM.

No promising speaking opportunity gets forgotten.

I know exactly which people need my personal attention.

Paid Skills Test

Final candidates will be given a short paid skills test.

You will receive several organizations and be asked to:

Research each organization.

Identify the person most likely responsible for booking speakers or workshops.

Find their contact information.

Briefly explain why the organization could be a good speaking opportunity.

Organize everything clearly in a spreadsheet.

Recommend the next action.

I will evaluate your work based on:

Accuracy, organization, judgment, English, attention to detail, and resourcefulness.

How to Apply

Please answer ALL of the following:

Tell me briefly about yourself.

What experience do you have with lead generation, outreach, CRM management, or administrative support?

Which CRM systems have you used?

Have you used GoHighLevel?

How have you used ChatGPT, Gemini, or other AI tools in your work?

What is your experience with Google Sheets?

Give me one example of a database, sales pipeline, or outreach process you have managed.

What is your hourly rate?

Are you available for 10 hours per week?

Why do you think you would be good at managing this type of system?

Please begin your application with these exact words:

SPEAKING OUTREACH

If those words are not at the beginning of your application, I will assume you did not read the entire job description.

Please do not send me a generic application. I am looking for someone who wants to become the person responsible for keeping this system organized and moving forward.

I'd post this first on OnlineJobs.ph. Don't hire the first impressive applicant. Get at least 10–15 applications, eliminate anyone who ignored the application instructions, and give the best 3–5 candidates the same paid test.

When you have the applications, bring them here. I'll help you compare the candidates against a scoring system so you're hiring for attention to detail and execution, not whoever interviews best.

title: Video Editor
description:
# Full-Time Video Editor



We’re looking for a **high-level Video Editor** to join our team full-time.



We are a **fast-moving startup media company** that partners with influencers and creators to build and scale digital products such as courses, coaching programs, communities, and education products that genuinely have a positive impact on people’s lives.



You’ll be editing content across **multiple clients and brands**, so you need to be fast, adaptable, creative, and comfortable switching between different editing styles.



## What You’ll Be Doing



* Editing short-form and long-form content

* Editing YouTube videos, reels, shorts, ads, and other social content

* Creating advanced motion graphics when required

* Adding strong sound design, captions, transitions, B-roll, and visual effects

* Matching existing client editing styles accurately

* Adapting to completely different brand styles across multiple clients

* Working from references and recreating editing styles

* Implementing feedback quickly

* Managing multiple edits and deadlines at once

* Delivering most projects within a **24-hour turnaround**



## Requirements



You must be highly proficient in at least one of:



* **CapCut**

* **DaVinci Resolve**

* **Adobe Premiere Pro**



You should also:



* Be capable of **advanced motion graphic editing**

* Understand pacing, retention, storytelling, sound design, typography, and visual hierarchy

* Know how to make content engaging without over-editing

* Be able to replicate different editing styles from references

* Be comfortable switching between multiple clients and brands

* Have strong attention to detail

* Be highly reliable with deadlines

* Communicate clearly and respond quickly

* Be able to take feedback without needing excessive direction

* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

* Be available for **40 hours per week**



Experience with **After Effects** is a major bonus.



## Hours



This is a **40-hour-per-week role**, Monday–Saturday.



A typical schedule would be:



**Monday:** 12 PM – 7 PM UK time

**Tuesday:** 12 PM – 7 PM UK time

**Wednesday:** 12 PM – 7 PM UK time

**Thursday:** 12 PM – 7 PM UK time

**Friday:** 12 PM – 7 PM UK time

**Saturday:** 12 PM – 5 PM UK time



The exact working hours are **flexible**.



You can work mornings, afternoons, or evenings depending on your timezone, but ideally you should have good overlap with normal UK waking/working hours so communication stays fast.



We care much more about **speed, output, reliability, and quality** than what exact time you start working.



## Compensation



**₱45,000–₱60,000 PHP per month**, depending on experience and ability.



There is room for compensation to increase over time for someone who consistently produces excellent work and becomes a key part of the team.



## IMPORTANT — How To Apply



**Do not just send a portfolio.**



Portfolios alone will **not be accepted**.



We want to see proof that you actually created the work.



Send us a **Loom video showing your real editing timelines** inside CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or whatever software you use.



In the Loom, walk us through:



* Your strongest edits

* The actual editing timelines

* How you built the edits

* Motion graphics you’ve created

* Different editing styles you’ve worked with

* Any particularly complex edits you’ve completed



We want to see the **actual project timelines**, not just exported finished videos.



## How To Apply



Start your application with:



**PINEAPPLE**



If your application does not include **PINEAPPLE**, it will automatically be ignored.



Then include:



1. Your Loom video showing your editing timelines

2. The software you primarily use

3. Your experience with motion graphics

4. Your timezone/location

5. Whether you can work 40 hours per week

6. Your current or expected monthly salary

7. How soon you can start



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term member of the team**, improve quickly, take ownership of their work, and grow alongside the company.

title: Podcast Video Editor for Shorts and Highlight Reels — CapCut and OpusClip
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented video editor to join our podcast and media production team.



You will turn long-form podcast interviews into engaging vertical shorts and condensed highlight videos using OpusClip and CapCut.



This is not an advanced animation or cinematic-editing position. We need someone with strong judgment who can identify compelling moments, create accurate captions, follow our branding, and deliver organized files on time.



You will initially work on content for:



The Amazing Authorities Podcast



Booked For TV



Interviews featuring CEOs, authors, speakers, consultants and experts



The right person can grow into a long-term position with additional hours and responsibilities.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Upload complete interviews into OpusClip



Review AI-generated clips and select the strongest moments



Create approximately three vertical shorts from each interview



Edit and polish clips in CapCut



Correct all captioning and spelling errors



Properly frame speakers for 9:16 vertical video



Remove unnecessary pauses and weak openings



Add approved logos, fonts, colors and closing screens



Create basic 3–5-minute highlight videos when requested



Export videos according to our specifications



Follow our file-naming system



Organize source files, project files and completed videos



Meet agreed deadlines and communicate promptly



Make reasonable corrections when errors are identified



REQUIRED SKILLS



Experience using CapCut



Experience using OpusClip or similar AI clipping software



Strong written English



Excellent attention to caption accuracy



Ability to identify strong hooks, stories and teaching moments



Understanding of YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn video



Reliable computer and internet connection



Ability to follow templates and detailed instructions



Good file-management habits



Reliable attendance and communication



OUR EDITING STYLE



Our audience includes business owners, authors, executives and professional experts. The videos should feel polished, credible and engaging.



We do not want excessive emojis, distracting transitions, unnecessary sound effects or frantic editing.



We prefer:



A strong opening within the first three seconds



Clean, accurate captions



Professional pacing



Tasteful zooms and reframing



Selective emphasis of important words



Consistent branding



Clear storytelling



Professional closing screens and calls to action



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Initial schedule: approximately 10–15 hours per week



First 30 days: $3 USD per hour



After successfully completing the 30-day introductory period: $4 USD per hour



Opportunity for additional hours as our production volume grows



Payments will be made according to an agreed schedule



The increase to $4 per hour will depend on:



Reliable attendance



Consistent communication



Meeting deadlines



Accurate captions



Correct branding



Proper file organization



Following instructions



Improving production speed



Producing strong clips without needing every timestamp supplied



PRODUCTION EXPECTATIONS



Training time will be provided during the first week.



Once trained, the general target is to complete a standard short-form package in approximately 60–90 minutes. A standard package will usually include:



Reviewing the OpusClip results



Selecting approximately three strong clips



Correcting captions



Applying our branding



Exporting and organizing the completed files



Some assignments may require a basic highlight video. More complicated assignments will be given an appropriate time allowance.



PAID EDITING TEST



Finalists will be invited to complete a small paid editing test using the same podcast footage.



The test will include:



Two vertical shorts



One short highlight video



Corrected captions



Proper branding and file names



A 48-hour turnaround



The test will help us evaluate clip selection, caption accuracy, pacing, communication, organization and ability to follow instructions.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about your editing experience



Links to three examples of podcast shorts or talking-head videos you personally edited



Your experience with CapCut



Your experience with OpusClip



Your computer specifications and internet speed



Your normal working hours in Philippine time



How many hours you are currently available each week



A brief explanation of how you select the strongest moment from a long interview



Confirmation that you accept the $3-per-hour introductory rate and $4-per-hour rate after successful completion of the first 30 days



Please begin your application with the words “AUTHORITY EDITOR” so we know you read the entire posting.



Applications without relevant work samples or the requested opening words may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants stable, long-term work and takes pride in accuracy, reliability and professional content.

title: Conversion-Focused Podcast & Social Media Copywriter
description:
Conversion-Focused Podcast & Social Media Copywriter



We’re looking for a strong, strategic copywriter to join our podcast production and social media marketing team.



This role is for someone who understands that great copy isn't just about sounding good, it needs to move the needle.



Our clients are entrepreneurs, CEOs, doctors, experts, thought leaders, and personal brands. We need a copywriter who knows how to turn their expertise into content that captures attention, builds authority, creates demand, and ultimately helps attract qualified leads.



This is not a basic AI copy-and-paste position.



We need someone who understands copywriting, social media marketing, audience psychology, lead generation, SEO, and conversion and can apply those skills differently for each client.



What You'll Be Writing



You'll create copy across multiple client accounts, including:



* Podcast show notes

* SEO-optimized YouTube titles and descriptions

* Instagram captions

* LinkedIn posts

*
 posts

* TikTok/Reels/Shorts copy

* High-converting hooks

* Calls-to-action (CTAs)

* Episode promotional copy

* SEO keywords

* Lead-generation content

* Authority-building content

* Repurposed content from podcast transcripts and long-form videos



We Need More Than a Good Writer



We need someone who understands why people stop scrolling, engage, click, follow, comment, DM, and ultimately become leads.



You should be able to look at a piece of podcast content and think strategically:



**What's the strongest hook?**



**What pain point will make this audience pay attention?**



**What angle will generate curiosity?**



**How can we position this client as the authority?**



**What CTA makes sense for this piece of content?**



**How can this post create a conversation that leads to business?**



**How do we turn attention into actual demand for the client's services?**



We're not interested in posting content simply to stay active on social media.



**The goal is strategic content that moves the needle.**



 What We're Looking For



Excellent written and spoken English is REQUIRED.



You should:



* Write fluent, natural English with excellent grammar

* Have strong direct-response or conversion copywriting skills

* Understand social media marketing and lead generation

* Know how to write hooks that immediately capture attention

* Understand buyer psychology and what motivates someone to take action

* Know how to turn educational content into demand for a client's services

* Understand how to build authority and trust through content

* Write compelling CTAs without making every post feel overly promotional

* Understand the differences between LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and TikTok audiences

* Know how to balance value-driven, authority-building and conversion-focused content

* Adapt to each client's unique voice and personality

* Understand SEO and keyword optimization

* Be able to identify the strongest ideas within long podcast transcripts

* Research unfamiliar industries and understand their target customers

* Be highly detail-oriented

* Manage multiple brands and deadlines

* Take ownership of results and quality



Understanding the Client's Voice Is Critical



We work with many different clients, and they should NOT all sound like the same copywriter.



A CEO should sound like that CEO.



A doctor should sound like that doctor.



A high-energy entrepreneur should sound like themselves.



Before writing, you should be able to understand the client's:



* Voice

* Personality

* Audience

* Offers

* Positioning

* Expertise

* Customer pain points

* Brand messaging

* Business goals



The copy should feel like the client wrote it... just strategically better.



AI Experience



We use AI tools as part of our workflow, so experience with ChatGPT, Claude, and similar tools is a plus.



However:



AI should assist your thinking. It should not do your thinking for you.



We do NOT want someone who copies a transcript into AI, generates captions, and submits them without reviewing or refining the output.



Every piece of copy needs human strategy behind it.



You are responsible for making sure the final copy:



* Sounds human

* Matches the client's voice

* Opens with a strong hook

* Speaks directly to the target audience

* Creates curiosity or conversation

* Builds authority

* Has a strategic CTA when appropriate

* Supports the client's business and lead-generation goals

* Is accurate to the original content

* Has been thoroughly proofread

* Does not sound generic or obviously AI-generated



You May Be a Great Fit If...



You can read a 45-minute podcast transcript and quickly identify:



**“That's the hook.”**



**“That should be the YouTube title.”**



**“This section speaks directly to the client's ideal buyer.”**



**“This could become a strong LinkedIn authority post.”**



**“That idea could generate comments and conversation.”**



**“We should connect this topic to the client's offer.”**



**“This CTA could turn engagement into leads.”**



That's the level of strategic thinking we're looking for.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your copywriting experience.

2. Examples of social media copy you've written.

3. Examples of content you've written specifically to generate leads, inquiries, sales, or conversions.

4. Examples of podcast show notes or YouTube descriptions, if available.

5. Any measurable results your copy has helped generate.

6. The AI tools you currently use and how you use them.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words **“COPY THAT CONVERTS”** so we know you read the full job description.



Required Writing Test



Choose a podcast, YouTube interview, or business video and provide:



* **3 different hooks** you would test on social media

* **1 Instagram/Facebook caption**

* **1 LinkedIn post**

* **1 SEO-friendly YouTube title**

* **A short YouTube description**

* **1 CTA designed to generate leads or inquiries**



Then briefly explain:



**Why did you choose these hooks and CTA, and how would they help move the audience toward becoming a lead?**



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our content team, understands marketing strategy, and takes real ownership of the copy and results we produce for our clients.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this. 



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management



 The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can eventually own the entire backend with minimal supervision.

You should be able to look at the operation and immediately understand:

What is working? What is not working? Where are we losing money? What needs to be fixed? Who needs to handle it? And what needs to happen next?

You must be comfortable taking ownership, communicating with suppliers and team members, analyzing numbers, solving problems, and stepping into the details when necessary.

We are looking for an operator, not someone who simply delegates tasks.



Requirements

✅ Solid e-commerce/dropshipping experience

✅ Experience with overseas suppliers/fulfillment

✅ Experience handling refunds and cancellations

✅ Strong dispute/chargeback experience

✅ Understanding of COGS and profit margins

✅ Experience managing or working with phone support teams

✅ Strong operational and analytical skills

✅ Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

✅ Full-time availability

✅ Willingness to work longer hours when operationally necessary

✅ Willingness to learn both backend and frontend operations

✅ Strong sense of ownership and accountability



Optional:

✅ Experience with AI and outsourcing

✅ CLaude code Chatgpt Codex

title: I am looking for a highly experienced Senior Laravel + Flutter Developer with real experience in food delivery systems,
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Flutter & Laravel Engineer / Technical Lead to perform an independent technical review of a production-ready food delivery platform before launch.



The platform is based originally on StackFood but has been heavily customized in UI/UX, application flows, and code.



The system includes:



Customer App

Restaurant App

Delivery Driver App

Laravel Backend / Admin Panel

Website

Google Maps / Geolocation

Firebase / Push Notifications

REST APIs



We already have an active developer and a dedicated QA tester.



This role is not intended to replace the current developer.

The selected engineer will work alongside the existing developer and QA team to review the system, identify root causes, validate technical quality, and ensure the platform is stable before launch.



Main Responsibilities

Perform a full technical audit of the current Flutter and Laravel codebase.

Review the overall architecture and identify weak or risky areas.

Investigate recurring bugs and identify their real root causes.

Review Flutter state management, navigation, forms, lifecycle, and application stability.

Review Google Maps, GPS, geolocation, delivery zones, address handling, and Android/iOS consistency.

Review Laravel APIs and communication between the apps and backend.

Review Firebase and push-notification flows.

Review authentication, registration, validation, and session flows.

Check for API inconsistencies, race conditions, poor error handling, and state-sync problems.

Review database/API logic where relevant.

Review Git workflow and code quality.

Work directly with the existing developer to explain findings and proposed fixes.

Review important fixes before release.

Help determine which issues must be resolved before production launch.

Required Experience



We are looking for a senior engineer, not a general junior/mid-level developer.



Strong experience required in:



Flutter / Dart

Laravel / PHP

Flutter State Management

REST APIs

Google Maps SDK

GPS / Geolocation

Google Places / Geocoding

Firebase / FCM

Android & iOS debugging

MySQL

Authentication / OTP flows

Git / Code Review

Application Architecture

Production debugging



Previous experience with food delivery, courier, taxi, logistics, marketplace, or other real-time location-based systems is strongly preferred.



Experience with StackFood / 6amTech is a plus, but not required.



Initial Engagement



We want to start with a paid technical audit.



The first task will be to review the platform and provide:



Main technical risks before launch.

Root causes behind recurring bugs.

Architecture/code-quality concerns.

Maps/location assessment.

Flutter/mobile stability assessment.

Laravel/API assessment.

Firebase/notification assessment.

Bugs that must be fixed before launch.

Recommended fixes and priorities.

Recommendation on whether additional development resources are required.



After the audit, there may be an opportunity for ongoing collaboration with our existing developer.



Important



We are not looking for someone who only converts Figma designs into Flutter.



We need someone who can investigate a problem across:



Flutter → API → Laravel → Database → Firebase → Mobile App



and determine where the real problem originates.



When Applying, Please Answer



1. Tell us about a delivery, taxi, courier, marketplace, or location-based platform you have worked on.



2. How would you investigate a bug where the same address works correctly on iOS but is rejected on Android?

9. Are you comfortable reviewing another developer's code and collaborating with them instead of replacing them?



10. What would you inspect during the first 5–10 hours of a technical audit for this type of platform?

title: Engineers Who Write: Long-Term Technical Article Writer (Briefs + Spec Provided)
description:
Full-time preferred (multiple part-time writers also considered).



We're looking for engineers — mechanical, civil, electrical, chemical, software, any discipline — who want steady remote writing work. If you've spent years working from specifications, drawings, and standards, you already have the core skill this job needs: reading a spec carefully and executing it exactly.



We're hiring a dedicated writer for a long-term, high-volume semantic SEO content project. This is steady, ongoing work with no planned end date — our current writers have been with us for five years, and strong writers will have as much work as they can handle, every week.



Why engineers do well here



Every article comes with a brief that works like a spec sheet: the structure is defined, the subtopics are listed, and the style rules are documented. There is no ambiguity to resolve and no creative direction to invent. Engineers who treat the brief as a requirements document and check their work against it line by line consistently outperform "creative" writers on this project.



What the work looks like



You'll receive a complete brief (outline) and a set of writing rules for every article. Your job is to research the topic and write to the brief — nothing else. No pitching topics, no guessing what we want. The brief tells you the structure and the subtopics to cover; the guidelines tell you the style: tone, sentence structure, vocabulary, expressions to use, and words to avoid.



Research is light to moderate — enough to write accurately about each point in the brief, not deep original investigation.



This job rewards precision, not creativity. If you enjoy following a clear system and getting it exactly right, you'll do very well here. If you prefer creative freedom, this isn't your project.



Important — this is 100% manual writing



AI-generated or AI-assisted drafts are not accepted. All articles are written in shared Google Docs with version history, and drafts are checked with AI-detection tools. If a draft flags, we review the edit history with you before making a call — but confirmed AI use ends the contract. If you write everything yourself, this will never be an issue for you.



Pay



$0.01–$0.03 per word depending on experience and aptitude, paid per completed article that passes our guidelines. At $0.02/word, a 5,000-word article = $100. Rates are reviewed as you demonstrate consistency with the system.



Because volume is unlimited, your monthly income is set by your own output. Writers who master our system can produce quickly and consistently — the guidelines feel dense on your first article and become second nature by your third.



Turnaround



Fast delivery matters. Once you're up to speed, the expectation is same-day or next-day turnaround per article.



How to apply



1. Start your application with the word "cornerstone" — applications without it will not be read.

2. Include 1–2 writing samples (informational articles preferred, not sales copy).

3. Tell us in one sentence how you make sure an article follows a detailed style guide.



What happens next

Premium

Modern

Professional

Commercially credible

Trustworthy

Clean

Fast

Conversion-focused



It should not look like a generic electrician template.



Breakdance experience is strongly preferred

Breakdance global styles

reusable sections

responsive controls

advanced layout

mobile optimisation

clean class structure

dynamic elements

performance optimisation

reusable design systems

Consumer Unit Upgrades

Rewiring

EICRs

Contact

I want you to think about:



strong above-the-fold positioning

premium typography

clear CTAs

trust signals

qualifications/accreditations

engineer/team credibility

service-area coverage

commercial project positioning

case study sections

testimonials

emergency call-out sections

commercial enquiry CTAs

mobile-first usability



The site must work equally well for someone looking for a domestic electrician and a facilities manager or commercial client looking for a larger contractor.



Important



I do not want someone who simply installs a theme and changes colours.



I am looking for a designer who can take an existing strategy and create something that feels custom, polished and significantly better than the average UK electrical contractor website.



Attention to detail matters.



Spacing, mobile layouts, section transitions, typography, CTA placement and overall visual consistency all need to be excellent.



Technical requirements



The site should be:



Built in WordPress

Fully responsive

Fast-loading

SEO-friendly

Easy to edit

Structured cleanly

brand/logo

website strategy

page structure

content direction

service list

credentials/accreditations

example websites/styles I like

feedback throughout the build

To apply

Your experience improving conversion rates / CTA structure

Your experience building websites for trades, construction, property, commercial services or similar sectors

Your fixed project price

title: Python Programmer
description:
We are a specialized insurance agency looking for an experienced Python developer to build a backend automation script that processes our monthly commission statements.

Our carriers send us statements in wildly different formats (PDFs, CSVs, and ZIP folders). We need a script that takes a batch upload of these files, uses the Google Gemini API to intelligently extract the data, and standardizes it into a strict CSV format required by our CRM.

The Good News: You won't have to start from scratch. We have already written the core API interface code and the complex prompt engineering required to parse the unpredictable PDFs. We will provide you with a comprehensive Project Brief containing this code, the exact data formatting rules, and a ZIP file of dummy statements for you to test against.

Your Responsibilities:

File Handling: Write the logic to accept a batch of files (or extract a .zip) and feed them to the API loop one by one.

User Interface: Wrap the script in a simple, lightweight GUI (like Streamlit or Tkinter) so our team can drag-and-drop files to process them without using a command line.

API Integration: Implement our provided Gemini API starter code, forcing the model to return structured JSON. Handle API rate limits gracefully (e.g., using time.sleep()).

Data Formatting: Write the Python logic to enforce strict formatting rules (e.g., ensuring all extracted dates are formatted strictly as MM/DD/YY, calculating a "Total" row, and flagging missing data).

Dynamic Export: Configure the script to output separate, dynamically named CSV files for each statement processed (e.g., [Company Name] [Month] [Year].csv).

Security: Ensure the script automatically deletes processed files from Google's servers immediately after generation to protect client data.

Requirements:

Strong proficiency in Python.

Experience working with the Google Generative AI SDK (google-generativeai).

High attention to detail (our CRM requires exact column headers and date formats).

Project Scope:

This is a well-documented, straightforward project. We estimate it will take a competent developer 4 to 8 hours to complete and thoroughly test against our dummy data suite.

This will act as a paid test project. If the code is resilient and the instructions are followed perfectly, we have ongoing freelance development work available.

title: Nurses, Pharmacists & Healthcare Professionals: Long-Term Remote Article Writer
description:
Full-time preferred (multiple part-time writers also considered).



Healthcare professionals — nurses, pharmacists, allied health, medical technologists, and clinicians looking for remote work — bring two things this project needs: strict adherence to protocol, and the ability to explain complex information in plain language.



We're hiring a dedicated writer for a long-term, high-volume semantic SEO content project. This is steady, ongoing work with no planned end date — our current writers have been with us for five years, and strong writers will have as much work as they can handle, every week.



Why healthcare professionals do well here



Charting, protocols, and documentation standards have trained you to follow written procedures exactly and record information accurately without embellishment. Our articles work the same way: a brief defines what to cover and in what order, and a style guide defines how to say it. Writers who follow the brief the way they'd follow a clinical protocol — every step, in order, nothing improvised — succeed here. Topics vary and are not limited to medical subjects; the skill we're hiring for is careful execution.



What the work looks like



You'll receive a complete brief (outline) and a set of writing rules for every article. Your job is to research the topic and write to the brief — nothing else. No pitching topics, no guessing what we want. The brief tells you the structure and the subtopics to cover; the guidelines tell you the style: tone, sentence structure, vocabulary, expressions to use, and words to avoid.



Research is light to moderate — enough to write accurately about each point in the brief, not deep original investigation.



This job rewards precision, not creativity. If you enjoy following a clear system and getting it exactly right, you'll do very well here. If you prefer creative freedom, this isn't your project.



Important — this is 100% manual writing



AI-generated or AI-assisted drafts are not accepted. All articles are written in shared Google Docs with version history, and drafts are checked with AI-detection tools. If a draft flags, we review the edit history with you before making a call — but confirmed AI use ends the contract. If you write everything yourself, this will never be an issue for you.



Pay



$0.01–$0.03 per word depending on experience and aptitude, paid per completed article that passes our guidelines. At $0.02/word, a 5,000-word article = $100. Rates are reviewed as you demonstrate consistency with the system.



Because volume is unlimited, your monthly income is set by your own output. Writers who master our system can produce quickly and consistently — the guidelines feel dense on your first article and become second nature by your third.



Turnaround



Fast delivery matters. Once you're up to speed, the expectation is same-day or next-day turnaround per article.



How to apply



1. Start your application with the word "cornerstone" — applications without it will not be read.





What happens next



Respond to this ad and we'll send you a short personality test. If it's a fit, you'll receive a test article with a full brief and our writing guidelines, so you'll see exactly how the system works. If you're hired, the test article is paid at the base rate of $0.01 per word.
