title: Real Estate Transaction & Commission Admin | Full-Time Remote
description:
Real Estate Transaction & Commission Admin | Full-Time Remote



Realty ONE Group MVP is one of Florida’s largest and fastest-growing real estate brokerages. We support more than 1,100 real estate agents with modern technology, coaching, and a strong operational infrastructure.



We are looking for a full-time Real Estate Transaction & Commission Admin to help keep our closed transaction files accurate, commissions processed correctly, outstanding fees tracked, and records ready for audits.



This is not a general virtual assistant position.



This is a structured, detail-focused role for someone who enjoys working with spreadsheets, checklists, transaction records, and financial data. You must be able to catch missing information, follow up consistently, and escalate issues according to clearly defined procedures.



The right person does not allow missing documents, unpaid fees, or data errors to quietly sit unresolved.



Position Overview



You will manage the daily tracking, data entry, and reporting behind transaction closeout, collections, commission verification, and financial reconciliation preparation.



You will support our Compliance and Accounting teams by keeping records current, identifying missing information, and flagging discrepancies before they become larger problems.



You will not be responsible for interpreting legal or compliance requirements, resolving commission disputes, approving fee waivers, writing off balances, or making financial decisions.



Your responsibility is to identify, document, track, follow up, and escalate. Final decisions remain with company leadership.



Key Responsibilities



Transaction File Closeout



- Enter and update closing information in our transaction management system.

- Review closed transaction files for accuracy and completeness.

- Follow a detailed file-closeout checklist.

- Confirm that all required documents are present before a file is marked ready for commission disbursement.

- Maintain trackers for missing HUDs, closing statements, transaction fees, and other required documents.

- Follow established 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day escalation procedures.

- Follow up on incomplete files until the missing information is received or escalated.



Collections and Revenue Tracking



- Track unpaid transaction fees and other outstanding balances.

- Follow up according to the company’s established collections schedule.

- Identify files where fees may be missing or revenue may be at risk.

- Document every follow-up attempt and maintain accurate collection records.

- Escalate unresolved balances according to company procedures.

- Never approve fee waivers or write-offs without authorization.



Compliance Support



- Review transaction files to confirm that required documents have been uploaded.

- Organize documentation in preparation for audits.

- Identify missing, incomplete, or incorrectly labeled documents.

- Escalate possible compliance concerns to the Compliance team.

- Do not make legal or compliance determinations.



Accounting and Commission Support



- Prepare intake logs and HUD trackers for weekly reconciliation.

- Compare commission information against transaction records.

- Identify and flag commission discrepancies.

- Assist with entity and bank-mapping accuracy checks under supervision.

- Maintain clean and organized financial tracking records.

- Escalate discrepancies rather than attempting to resolve matters outside your authority.



Weekly Reporting



- Prepare the weekly file-health and closeout-status report.

- Maintain an accurate list of open, aging, escalated, and resolved items.

- Report missing documents, unpaid fees, and commission discrepancies.

- Submit all required reports on time with a low data-entry error rate.



How Performance Will Be Measured



This is a scorecard-driven position. Performance will be reviewed weekly based on:



- Percentage of files closed out within the required timeframe.

- Number of files aging beyond established deadlines.

- Accuracy of transaction and commission data.

- Missing-document trackers being complete and current.

- Collection follow-ups completed within required timelines.

- Speed and accuracy when identifying discrepancies.

- Weekly reports submitted correctly and on time.

- Overall data-entry error rate.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have experience in real estate transaction coordination, bookkeeping support, commission processing, data entry, or back-office administration.

- Pay close attention to numbers, dates, documents, and small details.

- Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and repetitive checklists.

- Communicate clearly and professionally in written English.

- Follow established procedures without skipping steps.

- Know when to escalate an issue instead of making an unauthorized decision.

- Follow up consistently without needing repeated reminders.

- Can manage multiple open items without allowing deadlines to pass.

- Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently after training.

- Take pride in keeping records clean and accurate.



Requirements



- Previous experience in real estate administration, transaction coordination, bookkeeping support, commission processing, data entry, or a similar back-office role.

- Strong written English communication.

- Excellent spreadsheet and data-entry skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to follow detailed SOPs, checklists, and escalation procedures.

- Full-time availability, Monday through Friday.

- Availability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Reliable computer and quiet home workspace.

- Comfortable learning new software, CRM systems, and transaction-management platforms.

- Willing to have productivity and accuracy measured through a weekly scorecard.

- No conflicting full-time position.



What We Provide



- A clearly defined role with established responsibilities and escalation rules.

- Documented SOPs, checklists, and tracking systems.

- Training on our systems and internal processes.

- Direct access to department leaders when an issue must be escalated.

- Consistent full-time work with a stable and growing U.S. real estate brokerage.

- The opportunity to develop valuable experience in real estate transaction operations, commission processing, and financial administration.

- Long-term growth opportunities for someone who is accurate, dependable, and committed.



Why Join Realty ONE Group MVP?



You will be joining one of Florida’s largest and fastest-growing real estate brokerages during an important stage of our continued growth.



We are deliberately building an operations team that can support more than 1,100 agents while maintaining accurate records, clean financial data, and dependable internal processes.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of a clearly defined role and become the person our leadership team trusts to keep transaction and financial information accurate.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume.



2. A brief explanation of your experience with real estate transactions, commission processing, bookkeeping, financial administration, data entry, or tracking outstanding items.



3. Your answers to the following questions:



- What three tools have you used for spreadsheets, task tracking, transaction management, or file organization?

- Describe a time you caught an error or missing item before it became a larger problem. What did you do?

- How do you stay organized when managing multiple trackers, deadlines, and checklists?

- Have you worked with real estate transaction files, closing statements, HUDs, commissions, or transaction fees? Please explain.

- Are you available to work full-time with overlap during U.S. Eastern Time business hours?

- What is your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos?



4. Attach or provide a link to one relevant work sample, such as a spreadsheet, tracker, report, checklist, or data-management example. Please remove any confidential information before submitting it.



Applications that do not answer every question may not be considered.



Please begin your application with the words “Clean Data” so we know you read the entire posting.



Job Type: Full-time  

Work Location: Remote  

Schedule: Monday through Friday with U.S. Eastern Time overlap

title: Long-Term WordPress & Operations VA – UK Electrical Businesses
description:
I’m looking for a smart, reliable and proactive Virtual Assistant to join my growing group of UK electrical businesses on a long-term basis.



This is not a short-term freelance project. I’m looking for someone who can learn our systems, become part of the team and gradually take ownership of recurring operational tasks as the businesses grow.



Starting hours: Approx. 20 hours per week

Pay: $5–$7 USD per hour depending on experience

Bonuses/commission: Additional performance bonuses will be available for hitting agreed targets

Long-term opportunity: Hours and responsibilities can increase significantly for the right person



Main Responsibilities

WordPress / Website Work



We operate a growing portfolio of local electrician websites across the UK.



You will help us duplicate and adapt existing website templates for new UK locations.



This is not advanced web development and you will not be expected to create websites from scratch. I already have the site structure, templates, content framework and processes in place.



Typical tasks will include:



Editing WordPress websites

Duplicating existing website structures for new locations

Adapting existing pages for different UK towns and cities

Updating local information, service areas and location references

Using ChatGPT to help rewrite and localise existing content so pages are genuinely relevant to the new area, rather than simply replacing one town name with another

Updating phone numbers,
 addresses and contact information

Uploading and replacing images

Updating internal links

Checking pages carefully before launch

Following a detailed website-build and QA checklist



I will provide full step-by-step training and video recordings showing the exact process I currently use myself.



I will also provide access to a trained ChatGPT conversation/workflow that I already use when adapting websites for new locations. This will give you clear instructions on how content should be changed and should make the process much easier and faster.



You do not need to be an expert copywriter, but you must be comfortable using AI tools intelligently, following instructions and checking the output carefully rather than blindly copying and pasting content.



Experience with WordPress is required.



Experience with Cloudways and Namecheap would be a big advantage, particularly for connecting domains and basic website/domain management, although this is not essential and I can continue handling this initially.



Customer Calls & Lead Qualification



You will also gradually be trained to answer incoming calls for our UK electrician brands.



You will not be expected to diagnose electrical problems yourself.



Your role will be to speak professionally with customers, understand what they need and collect the information our electricians require.



This may include:



Answering incoming customer calls

Establishing what electrical work is required

Asking structured qualification questions

Confirming the customer’s location and availability

Explaining minimum attendance or call-out charges where appropriate

Identifying unsuitable or low-value enquiries

Requesting photographs or videos from customers via WhatsApp where required

Recording lead information accurately

Passing qualified opportunities to the relevant electrician or team member

Following up with customers where necessary

Keeping our lead tracking systems up to date



Full training and scripts will be provided.



Over time, you will learn how to recognise different types of electrical enquiries and what information our contractors need before they can quote or attend.



Communication Skills Are Extremely Important



Because you will eventually speak directly with UK customers, you must have:



Excellent spoken English

Clear and easy-to-understand pronunciation

A confident and professional telephone manner

Strong listening skills

Good written English

The ability to have a natural conversation rather than simply reading from a script

Confidence dealing with customers who may occasionally be impatient or difficult



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short voice recording and telephone role-play before hiring.



The Person I’m Looking For



You should be:



Extremely reliable

Detail-oriented

Fast at learning new processes

Comfortable following SOPs, checklists and structured workflows

Able to work independently once trained

Proactive when you notice something is wrong

Comfortable working with WordPress and online software

Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools as part of a structured workflow

Happy to ask questions when something is unclear rather than guessing

Interested in a long-term position rather than constantly changing clients



Experience working with UK, Australian, US or other English-speaking customers is a strong advantage.



Experience with Notion, Canva, Cloudways, Namecheap, Google Workspace or CRM systems would also be useful, although training can be provided.



Growth Opportunity



The businesses are growing quickly and I want this person to grow with us.



Initially, the role will focus heavily on website production, content adaptation and administration.



As you become familiar with the business, you will gradually take on more responsibility for:



Customer enquiries

Lead qualification

Website production

Operational administration

Contractor communication

Lead tracking

Customer follow-up

Day-to-day business processes



There will be performance bonuses and commission opportunities for hitting agreed targets, including website production and operational KPIs.



One of our initial targets will be producing approximately 8 properly completed and quality-checked website relocations per month once fully trained.



I value initiative, reliability and consistency, and I would much rather develop one excellent long-term team member than continually hire different freelancers.



There is significant opportunity for the right person to increase their hours and responsibilities as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Details of your WordPress experience.

Examples of the types of WordPress tasks you have completed previously.

Any experience you have dealing with customers by telephone.

Whether you have used Cloudways or Namecheap.

Whether you regularly use ChatGPT or other AI tools for work.

Your current availability and preferred working hours.

Your expected hourly rate.

A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be suitable for this role.



Please begin your application with the words “SURGE VA” so I know you have read the full job description.



Please only apply if you are looking for a genuine long-term position and are interested in growing with the company.
